nodes.name: app.ts
nodes.body_text: import { Hono } from "hono"; import type { Db } from "mongodb"; import { receivePolarWebhook } from "./webhooks"; import { receiveBioView } from "./bio-views"; import { bodyLimit } from "hono/body-limit";

nodes.name: AppDeps
nodes.body_text: interface AppDeps { db: Db; webhookSecret: string; health: () => Promise<boolean>; log: (message: string, error?: unknown) => void; bioViews?: Omit<Parameters<typeof receiveBioView>[1], "db">; }

nodes.name: createApp
nodes.body_text: function createApp(deps: AppDeps) { const app = new Hono(); app.post("/v1/bio/view", bodyLimit({ maxSize: 4096 }), async (c) => deps.bioViews ? receiveBioView(c.req.raw, { ...deps.bioViews, db: deps.db }) : c.json({ error: "disabled" }, 404), ); app.get("/__health", async (c) => (await deps.health()) ? c.json({ ok: true }) : c.json({ ok: false }, 503), ); app.post("/webhooks/polar", async (c) => { const headers: Record<string, string> = {}; c.req.raw.headers.forEach((value, key) => { headers[key] = value; }); const result = await receivePolarWebhook( { body: await c.req.text(), headers, secret: deps.webhookSecret }, deps, ); return c.json(result, result.status); }); app.notFound((c) => c.json({ error: "not_found" }, 404)); app.onError((error, c) => { deps.log("api error", error); return c.json({ error: "internal" }, 500); }); return app; }

nodes.body_text: import { activeDomain } from "@shortn/core"; import { physicalNames } from "@shortn/db"; import { keys } from "@shortn/redis"; import { createHmac } from "node:crypto"; import { ObjectId, type Db } from "mongodb"; import type { Redis } from "ioredis"; import { isbot } from "isbot"; import { z } from "zod"; const input = z.object({ pageId: z.string().regex(/^[a-f\d]{24}$/i), referrer: z.string().max(2048).optional(), });

nodes.name: receiveBioView
nodes.signature: async function receiveBioView( request: Request, deps: { db: Db; durable: Pick<Redis, "eval" | "set" | "xadd">; secret: string; rootOrigin: string; webOrigin?: string | undefined; subdomains: boolean; }, )
nodes.body_text: async function receiveBioView( request: Request, deps: { db: Db; durable: Pick<Redis, "eval" | "set" | "xadd">; secret: string; rootOrigin: string; webOrigin?: string | undefined; subdomains: boolean; }, ) { const headers = new Headers({ "Cache-Control": "no-store", Vary: "Origin" }); if ( request.headers.get("dnt") === "1" || isbot(request.headers.get("user-agent") ?? "") ) return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers }); const body = await request.text(); if (body.length > 4096) return new Response(null, { status: 413, headers }); let raw: unknown; try { raw = JSON.parse(body); } catch { return new Response(null, { status: 400, headers }); } const parsed = input.safeParse(raw); if (!parsed.success) return new Response(null, { status: 400, headers }); const page = await deps.db .collection(physicalNames.bio_pages) .findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(parsed.data.pageId), published: true }); if (!page?.workspaceId) return new Response(null, { status: 404, headers }); const origin = request.headers.get("origin"); if (!origin) return new Response(null, { status: 403, headers }); const allowed = new Set([ deps.rootOrigin, ...(deps.webOrigin ? [new URL(deps.webOrigin).origin] : []), ]); if (deps.subdomains && page.handle) { const root = new URL(deps.rootOrigin); allowed.add(`${root.protocol}//${page.handle}.${root.host}`); } if (!allowed.has(origin)) { let hostname: string; try { hostname = new URL(origin).hostname; } catch { return new Response(null, { status: 403, headers }); } const domain = await activeDomain(deps.db, hostname); if ( !domain || String(domain.bioPageId) !== String(page._id) || origin !== `https://${hostname}` ) return new Response(null, { status: 403, headers }); } headers.set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", origin); const ip = request.headers.get("cf-connecting-ip") ?? "unknown"; const hash = createHmac("sha256", deps.secret).update(ip).digest("hex"); const count = await deps.durable.eval( "local n=redis.call('INCR',KEYS[1]); if n==1 then redis.call('EXPIRE',KEYS[1],60) end; return n", 1, `bio-view-rate:${hash}`, ); if (Number(count) > 60) return new Response(null, { status: 429, headers }); if ( !(await deps.durable.set( `bio-view-once:${hash}:${page._id}`, "1", "EX", 1800, "NX", )) ) return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers }); let refDomain: string | undefined; try { if (parsed.data.referrer) refDomain = new URL(parsed.data.referrer).hostname; } catch { /* Ignore malformed attribution. */ } await deps.durable.xadd( keys.clicksStream, "*", "d", JSON.stringify({ v: 1, kind: "bio_view", pageId: String(page._id), workspaceId: String(page.workspaceId), ts: Date.now(), refDomain, country: request.headers.get("cf-ipcountry")?.slice(0, 8), }), ); return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers }); }

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.body_text: import { getDb, closeMongoClient } from "@shortn/db"; import { apiEnv, parseEnv } from "@shortn/env"; import { createApp } from "./app"; import { createRedisClients } from "@shortn/redis"; const env = parseEnv(apiEnv, process.env); const db = await getDb({ url: env.MONGODB_URL, database: env.MONGODB_DB, maxPoolSize: env.MONGODB_POOL_SIZE, }); const redis = env.BIO_DELIVERY_ENABLED === "1" ? await createRedisClients({ NODE_ENV: env.NODE_ENV, REDIS_CACHE_URL: env.REDIS_CACHE_URL!, REDIS_DURABLE_URL: env.REDIS_DURABLE_URL!, }) : undefined; const app = createApp({ ...(redis && env.IP_HASH_SECRET && env.PUBLIC_ORIGIN ? { bioViews: { durable: redis.durable, secret: env.IP_HASH_SECRET, rootOrigin: env.PUBLIC_ORIGIN, webOrigin: env.BIO_WEB_ORIGIN, subdomains: env.BIO_SUBDOMAINS === "1", }, } : {}), db, webhookSecret: env.POLAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET, log, }); const server = Bun.serve({ port: env.PORT, hostname: "0.0.0.0", fetch: app.fetch, }); console.log(`api listening on ${server.port}`); let stopping = false; process.on("SIGTERM", shutdown); process.on("SIGINT", shutdown);

nodes.name: log
nodes.body_text: log = (message: string, error?: unknown) => error === undefined ? console.log(message) : console.error(message, error)

nodes.name: health
nodes.body_text: async health() { try { await db.command({ ping: 1 }); return true; } catch { return false; } }

nodes.name: shutdown
nodes.body_text: async function shutdown() { if (stopping) return; stopping = true; redis?.cache.disconnect(); redis?.durable.disconnect(); await server.stop(); await closeMongoClient(); process.exit(0); }

nodes.body_text: import { validateEvent, WebhookVerificationError, } from "@polar-sh/sdk/webhooks"; import { Webhook } from "standardwebhooks"; import type { VerifiedEvent } from "./webhooks"; import { WebhookSubscriptionCreatedPayload$inboundSchema as subscriptionCreated } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhooksubscriptioncreatedpayload.js"; import { WebhookSubscriptionUpdatedPayload$inboundSchema as subscriptionUpdated } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhooksubscriptionupdatedpayload.js"; import { WebhookSubscriptionActivePayload$inboundSchema as subscriptionActive } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhooksubscriptionactivepayload.js"; import { WebhookSubscriptionCanceledPayload$inboundSchema as subscriptionCanceled } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhooksubscriptioncanceledpayload.js"; import { WebhookSubscriptionUncanceledPayload$inboundSchema as subscriptionUncanceled } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhooksubscriptionuncanceledpayload.js"; import { WebhookSubscriptionRevokedPayload$inboundSchema as subscriptionRevoked } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhooksubscriptionrevokedpayload.js"; import { WebhookSubscriptionPastDuePayload$inboundSchema as subscriptionPastDue } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhooksubscriptionpastduepayload.js"; import { WebhookOrderCreatedPayload$inboundSchema as orderCreated } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhookordercreatedpayload.js"; import { WebhookOrderUpdatedPayload$inboundSchema as orderUpdated } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhookorderupdatedpayload.js"; import { WebhookOrderPaidPayload$inboundSchema as orderPaid } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhookorderpaidpayload.js"; import { WebhookOrderRefundedPayload$inboundSchema as orderRefunded } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhookorderrefundedpayload.js"; import { WebhookCustomerStateChangedPayload$inboundSchema as customerStateChanged } from "@polar-sh/sdk/models/components/webhookcustomerstatechangedpayload.js"; const schemas = { "subscription.created": subscriptionCreated, "subscription.updated": subscriptionUpdated, "subscription.active": subscriptionActive, "subscription.canceled": subscriptionCanceled, "subscription.uncanceled": subscriptionUncanceled, "subscription.revoked": subscriptionRevoked, "subscription.past_due": subscriptionPastDue, "order.created": orderCreated, "order.updated": orderUpdated, "order.paid": orderPaid, "order.refunded": orderRefunded, "customer.state_changed": customerStateChanged, }; // Polar secrets generated since 2026-09-08 use Standard Webhooks key // derivation. SDK 0.49 still verifies the older literal UTF-8 secret. // Keep its payload schemas and legacy verifier during the transition.

nodes.name: verifyPolarWebhook
nodes.signature: function verifyPolarWebhook( body: string, headers: Record<string, string>, secret: string, ): VerifiedEvent
nodes.body_text: function verifyPolarWebhook( body: string, headers: Record<string, string>, secret: string, ): VerifiedEvent { try { return validateEvent(body, headers, secret); } catch (error) { if ( !(error instanceof WebhookVerificationError) || !secret.startsWith("whsec_") ) throw error; } let parsed: unknown; try { parsed = new Webhook(secret).verify(body, headers); } catch (error) { if (error instanceof Error) throw new WebhookVerificationError(error.message); throw error; } if ( !parsed || typeof parsed !== "object" || !("type" in parsed) || typeof parsed.type !== "string" ) throw new Error("Invalid Polar webhook payload"); if (Object.hasOwn(schemas, parsed.type)) return schemas[parsed.type as keyof typeof schemas].parse(parsed); // Signed non-billing events require no subscription work. Persist their // delivery id so future/irrelevant event types are still idempotent. return { type: parsed.type, data: {} }; }

nodes.name: webhooks.test.ts
nodes.body_text: import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test"; import { MongoClient } from "mongodb"; import { createHmac } from "node:crypto"; import { orderFixture } from "../../../packages/billing/test-fixtures/order"; import { receivePolarWebhook, subscriptionIdsOf, type Verify, } from "./webhooks"; const secret = "polar-test-secret-1234567890abcdef"; test("a bad or missing signature is refused with 403", async () => { const deps = { db: new MongoClient("mongodb://127.0.0.1:1").db("never"), log: () => {}, }; const result = await receivePolarWebhook( { body: "{}", headers: { "webhook-id": "msg_1", "webhook-timestamp": `${Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)}`, "webhook-signature": "v1,AAAA", }, secret, }, deps, ); expect(result.status).toBe(403); }); const mongoUrl = process.env.MONGO_TEST_URL; (mongoUrl ? describe : describe.skip)("with Mongo", () => { test("signed SDK order events reject tampering and expired signatures and deduplicate 10 deliveries", async () => { const client = await new MongoClient(mongoUrl ?? "").connect(); const db = client.db( `shortn_signed_webhook_${crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "")}`, ); const body = JSON.stringify({ type: "order.paid", timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), data: { ...orderFixture("sub_signed", "cus_signed", "owner"), status: "paid", }, }); const input = signed("msg_signed", Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)); try { expect( await receivePolarWebhook({ ...input, body: body + " " }, { db }), ).toEqual({ status: 403 }); expect( await receivePolarWebhook( signed("msg_expired", Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) - 3600), { db }, ), ).toEqual({ status: 403 }); expect(await db.collection("billing_events").countDocuments()).toBe(0); expect(await receivePolarWebhook(input, { db })).toEqual({ status: 202, id: "msg_signed", subscriptionIds: ["sub_signed"], }); for (let repeat = 0; repeat < 9; repeat++) expect(await receivePolarWebhook(input, { db })).toEqual({ status: 200, duplicate: true, }); expect(await db.collection("billing_events").countDocuments()).toBe(1); } finally { await db.dropDatabase(); await client.close(); } }); test("first delivery is stored and enqueued; replays are 200 duplicates", async () => { const client = await new MongoClient(mongoUrl ?? "").connect(); const db = client.db( `shortn_api_test_${crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "")}`, ); const deps = { db, log: () => {}, verify, }; const input = { body: "{}", headers: { "webhook-id": "msg_9" }, secret }; try { expect(await receivePolarWebhook(input, deps)).toEqual({ status: 202, id: "msg_9", subscriptionIds: ["sub_1"], }); for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) expect(await receivePolarWebhook(input, deps)).toEqual({ status: 200, duplicate: true, }); expect(await db.collection("billing_events").countDocuments()).toBe(1); } finally { await db.dropDatabase(); await client.close(); } }); }); test("subscription ids come from subscription, order and customer-state events", () => { const ids = subscriptionIdsOf; expect(ids({ type: "subscription.canceled", data: { id: "s" } })).toEqual([ "s", ]); expect(ids({ type: "order.paid", data: { subscriptionId: "s2" } })).toEqual([ "s2", ]); expect(ids({ type: "order.paid", data: { subscriptionId: null } })).toEqual( [], ); expect( ids({ type: "customer.state_changed", data: { activeSubscriptions: [{ id: "a" }, { id: "b" }] }, }), ).toEqual(["a", "b"]); expect(ids({ type: "checkout.created", data: {} })).toEqual([]); }); test("current Polar secrets accept spec signatures and reject tampering, wrong keys and expired timestamps", async () => { const { verifyPolarWebhook } = await import("./polar-webhook"); const key = Buffer.alloc(32, 17); const modernSecret = `whsec_${key.toString("base64")}`; const body = JSON.stringify({ type: "order.paid", timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), data: { ...orderFixture("sub_modern", "cus_modern", "owner"), status: "paid", }, }); const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000); const headers = signed(now); expect( subscriptionIdsOf(verifyPolarWebhook(body, headers, modernSecret)), ).toEqual(["sub_modern"]); for (const input of [ { body: body + " ", headers }, { body, headers: signed(now, Buffer.alloc(32, 18)) }, { body, headers: signed(now - 3600) }, { body, headers: signed(now + 3600) }, { body, headers: {} }, ]) { expect(() => verifyPolarWebhook(input.body, input.headers, modernSecret), ).toThrow(); } // Existing endpoints retain literal-secret signatures, even with whsec_. const legacyHeaders = signed(now, Buffer.from(modernSecret)); expect( subscriptionIdsOf(verifyPolarWebhook(body, legacyHeaders, modernSecret)), ).toEqual(["sub_modern"]); });

nodes.body_text: import { WebhookVerificationError } from "@polar-sh/sdk/webhooks"; import { verifyPolarWebhook } from "./polar-webhook"; import { collection } from "@shortn/db"; import type { Db } from "mongodb"; // The fields this handler reads; every validated Polar event satisfies it. // Which subscriptions an event concerns; everything else is recorded but // needs no mirror work.

nodes.name: VerifiedEvent
nodes.body_text: interface VerifiedEvent { type: string; data: object; }

nodes.name: Verify
nodes.signature: type Verify = ( body: string, headers: Record<string, string>, secret: string, ) => VerifiedEvent;
nodes.body_text: type Verify = ( body: string, headers: Record<string, string>, secret: string, ) => VerifiedEvent;

nodes.name: field
nodes.body_text: field = (data: object, name: string): unknown => Reflect.get(data, name)

nodes.name: stringField
nodes.body_text: stringField = (data: object, name: string) => { const value = field(data, name); return typeof value === "string" && value ? [value] : []; }

nodes.name: subscriptionIdsOf
nodes.body_text: function subscriptionIdsOf(event: VerifiedEvent): string[] { if (event.type.startsWith("subscription.")) return stringField(event.data, "id"); if (event.type.startsWith("order.")) return stringField(event.data, "subscriptionId"); if (event.type === "customer.state_changed") { const active = field(event.data, "activeSubscriptions"); return Array.isArray(active) ? active.flatMap((sub: unknown) => sub && typeof sub === "object" ? stringField(sub, "id") : [], ) : []; } return []; }

nodes.name: WebhookResult
nodes.signature: type WebhookResult = | { status: 403 } | { status: 200; duplicate: true } | { status: 202; id: string; subscriptionIds: string[] };
nodes.body_text: type WebhookResult = | { status: 403 } | { status: 200; duplicate: true } | { status: 202; id: string; subscriptionIds: string[] };

nodes.name: receivePolarWebhook
nodes.signature: async function receivePolarWebhook( input: { body: string; headers: Record<string, string>; secret: string }, deps: { db: Db; verify?: Verify; log?: (message: string, error?: unknown) => void; }, ): Promise<WebhookResult>
nodes.body_text: async function receivePolarWebhook( input: { body: string; headers: Record<string, string>; secret: string }, deps: { db: Db; verify?: Verify; log?: (message: string, error?: unknown) => void; }, ): Promise<WebhookResult> { let event: VerifiedEvent; try { event = (deps.verify ?? verifyPolarWebhook)( input.body, input.headers, input.secret, ); } catch (error) { if (error instanceof WebhookVerificationError) { deps.log?.("polar webhook verification failed", error); return { status: 403 }; } throw error; } const id = input.headers["webhook-id"]; if (!id) return { status: 403 }; const subscriptionIds = subscriptionIdsOf(event); try { await collection(deps.db, "billing_events").insertOne({ _id: id, type: event.type, subscriptionIds, receivedAt: new Date(), }); } catch (error) { if (error instanceof Error && "code" in error && error.code === 11000) return { status: 200, duplicate: true }; throw error; } // apps/worker picks up unprocessed events within seconds (16 D4). return { status: 202, id, subscriptionIds }; }

Exhaustive over the source data, rather than a ranked sample. const url = process.env.MONGO_TEST_URL ?? process.env.MONGODB_URL; const name = process.env.MONGODB_DB; if (!url || !name) throw new Error("MONGODB_URL and MONGODB_DB are required"); const origin = process.env.PUBLIC_ORIGIN ?? "https://shortn.at"; try { const db = await getDb({ url, database: name }); const pages = await db .collection(physicalNames.bio_pages) .find({ $or: [{ publicationManaged: { $ne: true } }, { published: true }] }) .toArray(); const aliases = await db .collection(physicalNames.bio_aliases) .find({}) .toArray(); const expected = new Map<string, string>(); for (const page of pages) for (const slug of [page.slug, page.legacySlug]) if (typeof slug === "string") expected.set(slug, String(page._id)); for (const alias of aliases) expected.set(String(alias.slug), String(alias.bioPageId)); const mismatches: string[] = []; for (const [slug, id] of expected) { const page = await resolveLegacyBio(db, slug); if (!page || String(page._id) !== id) { mismatches.push(slug); continue; } const target = bioCanonical( String(page.handle), origin, process.env.BIO_SUBDOMAINS === "1", ); if (process.env.BIO_PARITY_ORIGIN) { for (const suffix of ["", "/"]) { const response = await fetch( new URL( `/b/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}${suffix}`, process.env.BIO_PARITY_ORIGIN, ), { redirect: "manual" }, ); if ( response.status !== 301 || response.headers.get("location") !== target ) mismatches.push(`${slug}${suffix}: ${response.status}`); } } } console.log( JSON.stringify( { slugs: expected.size, matched: expected.size - new Set(mismatches.map((s) => s.split(":")[0])).size, mismatches, }, null, 2, ), ); if (mismatches.length) process.exitCode = 1; } finally { await closeMongoClient(); }

"", }; const client = await new MongoClient(url).connect(); try { const db = client.db(database); const codes = await db .collection(physicalNames.links) .distinct("urlCode", { urlCode: { $type: "string" } }); const qrCodes = await db .collection(physicalNames.qr_codes) .distinct("urlId", { urlId: { $type: "string" } }); const paths = [ ...codes.map((code) => `/${encodeURIComponent(String(code))}`), ...qrCodes.map((code) => `/qr/${encodeURIComponent(String(code))}`), "/parity-check-missing-key-1", "/qr/parity-check-missing-key-2", ]; const mismatches: { path: string; legacy: string; redirect: string }[] = []; let checked = 0; const queue = [...paths]; await Promise.all( Array.from({ length: 8 }, async () => { for (let path = queue.shift(); path; path = queue.shift()) { const [legacy, redirect] = await Promise.all([ outcome(legacyOrigin, path), outcome(redirectOrigin, path), ]); if (legacy !== redirect) mismatches.push({ path, legacy, redirect }); if (++checked % 250 === 0) console.log( `${checked}/${paths.length} checked, ${mismatches.length} mismatches`, ); } }), ); console.log( JSON.stringify({ checked, links: codes.length, qrPaths: qrCodes.length, mismatches: mismatches.length, }), ); for (const mismatch of mismatches.slice(0, 50)) console.log(JSON.stringify(mismatch)); process.exitCode = mismatches.length ? 1 : 0; } finally { await client.close(); }

"ink" : "paper"}&embed=1`, ); for (let retry = 0; response?.status() === 404 && retry < 4; retry++) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 400)); response = await page.reload(); } assert.equal(response?.status(), 200); await page.locator(".bio-page").waitFor(); assert.equal(await page.locator(".bio-link").count(), count); assert.equal( await page.locator(".bio-link img").count(), Math.ceil(count / 3), ); for (const image of await page.locator(".bio-link img").all()) { const box = await image.boundingBox(); assert( box && box.width === 48 && box.height === 48, "Thumbnails retain their dimensions", ); } assert.equal( await page.locator("iframe").count(), 0, "Embeds must wait for consent", ); const geometry = await page.evaluate(() => ({ viewport: innerWidth, width: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, })); assert( geometry.width <= geometry.viewport, `Overflow at ${width}/${locale}/${count}`, ); if (count === 25 && locale === "pt") { await page.screenshot({ path: `.impeccable/review/p5/${width === 390 ? const ctx = { db, cache, workspace, actor: { userId: String(user._id), role: "owner" }, linkDomain: "localhost:3102", } as unknown as ServiceContext; const suffix = new ObjectId().toHexString().slice(-8), title = `Campaign library ${suffix}`; const campaign = await createCampaign(ctx, { title }); assert(campaign.ok); const campaignId = new ObjectId(campaign.value.id), tagIds = [new ObjectId(), new ObjectId()]; const tagNames = [`Campaign Alpha ${suffix}`, `Campaign Beta ${suffix}`]; const docs = Array.from({ length: 1005 }, (_, at) => { const group = at < 1001 ? 0 : 1, key = `campaign-browser-${suffix}-${at}`; return { _id: new ObjectId(), workspaceId: workspace._id, key, urlCode: key, title: `Campaign sample ${String(at).padStart(4, "0")}`, domain: "localhost:3102", longUrl: `https://example.com/${key}`, date: new Date(), hidden: true, tags: [ { _id: tagIds[group], tagName: tagNames[group], name: tagNames[group] }, ], }; await button("Use 20 selected links").waitFor(); await button("Next").click(); await button("Select group on this page").click(); await button("Use 40 selected links").waitFor(); await tag(tagNames[1]!); await library.getByText(/1,005 matching links/).waitFor(); const filter = library.getByRole("combobox", { name: "Filter by tags", exact: true, }); assert.equal(await filter.innerText(), "2 tags"); const tagBox = (await filter.boundingBox())!, groupBox = (await library .getByLabel("Group results", { exact: true }) .boundingBox())!; assert( tagBox.x + tagBox.width < groupBox.x, "Tag selector overlaps grouping", ); await button(`Remove tag ${tagNames[0]}`).click(); await library.getByText(/4 matching links/).waitFor(); await button("Select this page").click(); await button("Use 44 selected links").waitFor(); await mkdir(".impeccable/review", { recursive: true }); if (process.argv.includes("--capture")) await page.screenshot({ path: ".impeccable/review/campaign-library-desktop.png", fullPage: true, }); await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 }); assert( await page.evaluate( () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth, ), "Campaign mobile overflow", ); const clipping = await library.evaluate((root) => { const bounds = root.getBoundingClientRect(); return [...root.querySelectorAll("input,button,select")] .filter((el) => { const box = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return ( box.width > 0 && (box.left < bounds.left - 1 || box.right > bounds.right + 1) ); }) .map((el) => el.outerHTML.slice(0, 100)); }); assert.deepEqual(clipping, [], "Campaign picker clips controls"); if (process.argv.includes("--capture")) await page.screenshot({ path: ".impeccable/review/campaign-library-mobile.png", fullPage: true, }); await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1440, height: 1000 }); await button("Use 44 selected links").click(); assert.equal( await page.locator('input[type="hidden"][name="link"]').count(), 44, ); await params(); await page .getByRole("button", { name: "Save variants on 44 links", exact: true }) .click(); await page.waitForURL((url) => url.searchParams.get("variants") === "44"); const variantFilter = { workspaceId: workspace._id, "utmLinks.campaign.title": title, }; assert.equal( await db.collection(physicalNames.links).countDocuments(variantFilter), 44, ); await open(); await button("Clear selection").click(); await tag(tagNames[1]!); await library.getByText(/4 matching links/).waitFor(); await button("Select all results").click(); await button("Use 4 selected links").click(); await params(); await page .getByRole("button", { name: "Save variants on 4 links", exact: true }) .click(); await page.waitForURL( (url) => url.searchParams.get("variants") === "0" && url.searchParams.get("skipped") === "4", ); assert.equal( await db.collection(physicalNames.links).countDocuments(variantFilter), 44, ); await open(); await button("Clear selection").click(); await tag(tagNames[0]!); await library.getByText(/1,001 matching links/).waitFor(); await button("Select all results").click(); await button("Use 500 selected links").waitFor(); assert(await button("Select all results").isDisabled()); await button("Use 500 selected links").click(); assert.equal( await page.locator('input[type="hidden"][name="link"]').count(), 500, ); const validId = (await page .locator('input[type="hidden"][name="link"]') .first() .getAttribute("value"))!; const before = await db .collection(physicalNames.links) .findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(validId) }); await page .locator('input[type="hidden"][name="link"]') .evaluateAll((inputs, foreignId) => { inputs.slice(2).forEach((input) => input.remove()); (inputs[1] as HTMLInputElement).value = foreignId; }, String(foreign._id)); await page .getByRole("button", { name: "Save variants on 500 links", exact: true }) .click(); await page .getByRole("alert") .filter({ hasText: /no longer exists/ }) .waitFor(); assert.deepEqual( ( await db .collection(physicalNames.links) .findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(validId) }) )?.utmLinks, before?.utmLinks, ); assert.equal( (await db.collection(physicalNames.links).findOne({ _id: foreign._id })) ?.utmLinks, undefined, ); assert.equal(await page.getByRole("dialog").count(), 0); assert.deepEqual(errors, []); await db.collection(physicalNames.tags).deleteMany({ _id: { $in: tagIds } }); cache.disconnect(); await client.close(); }

nodes.body_text: async function uploadFixtureImage( page: Page, label: string, whileUploading?: () => Promise<void>, ) { let release: (() => void) | undefined; if (whileUploading) { const gate = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; }); await page.route( "**/api/uploads/**", async (route) => { await gate; await route.continue(); }, { times: 1 }, ); } const response = page.waitForResponse( (response) => response.url().includes("/api/uploads/") && response.request().method() === "POST", ); await page.getByLabel(label, { exact: true }).setInputFiles({ name: "fixture.svg", mimeType: "image/svg+xml", buffer: fixtureSvg, }); if (whileUploading) { try { await whileUploading(); } finally { release?.(); } } const result = await response; assert.equal(result.status(), 200, await result.text()); const { url } = await result.json(); assert.match( url, /\/api\/assets\/uploads\/workspaces\/[a-f0-9]{24}\/[a-f0-9-]{36}\.png$/, ); await page.locator(`img[src="${url}"]`).first().waitFor(); await page.waitForFunction( (url) => [...document.images].some( (image) => image.src === url && image.complete && image.naturalWidth > 0, ), url, { timeout: 15_000 }, ); return url as string; }

Never points at staging/production data. */ import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"; import { parseEnv as parseDotenv } from "node:util"; import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url"; import { spawn, type ChildProcess } from "node:child_process"; import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto"; import { MongoClient, ObjectId } from "mongodb"; import { Redis } from "ioredis"; import { hashPassword } from "better-auth/crypto"; import { legacyCollectionKeys, physicalNames, syncIndexes } from "@shortn/db"; import { createBioPage, createLink, ensurePersonalWorkspace, publishBioDraft, readBioDraft, saveBioDraft, type ServiceContext, } from "@shortn/core"; import { bioPresets } from "@shortn/core/bio-content"; import { devConfig } from "../../../scripts/dev-config"; const root = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../../", import.meta.url)); const source = parseDotenv(await readFile(`${root}.env.staging`, "utf8")); const web = "http://localhost:3100"; const { shared, ports } = devConfig( { ...source, MONGODB_URL: "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27020/?replicaSet=rs0", MONGODB_DB: "shortn_p5_dev", REDIS_CACHE_URL: "redis://127.0.0.1:16380/5", REDIS_DURABLE_URL: "redis://127.0.0.1:16379/5", S3_ENDPOINT: "http://127.0.0.1:19000", S3_REGION: "us-east-1", S3_BUCKET: "shortn-dev", S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "shortn-local", S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "shortn-local-development-secret", LINK_DOMAIN: "localhost:3102", EDGE_AUTH_SECRET: "", BIO_DELIVERY_ENABLED: "1", BIO_SUBDOMAINS: "0", BIO_LEGACY_REDIRECTS: "0", BIO_API_ORIGIN: "http://localhost:3103", BIO_WEB_ORIGIN: web, BIO_INTERNAL_SECRET: randomBytes(32).toString("hex"), DOMAIN_WRITES: "0", BILLING_WRITES: "0", RUN_CONTINUOUS_MIGRATIONS: "0", MAIL_ALLOWLIST: "nobody@shortn.invalid", CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: "", CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID: "", POLAR_DOMAIN_PRODUCT_ID: "", }, { DEV_WEB_PORT: "3100", DEV_REDIRECT_PORT: "3102", DEV_API_PORT: "3103", DEV_WORKER_PORT: "3104", }, ); const client = await new MongoClient(shared.MONGODB_URL!).connect(); const db = client.db(shared.MONGODB_DB), cache = new Redis(shared.REDIS_CACHE_URL!); const email = "p5@example.test", password = `Shortn-P5-${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}!`, now = new Date(); let credentials: { email: string; password: string; dashboard: string; editor: string; bio: string; }; try { const existing = new Set( (await db.listCollections({}, { nameOnly: true }).toArray()).map( (c) => c.name, ), ); for (const key of legacyCollectionKeys) if (!existing.has(physicalNames[key])) await db.createCollection(physicalNames[key]); await syncIndexes(db); const user = await db.collection(physicalNames.user).findOne({ email }); const userId = user?._id ?? new ObjectId(); await db .collection(physicalNames.user) .updateOne( { _id: userId }, { $set: { name: "P5 Studio", username: "p5studio", displayUsername: "p5studio", email, emailVerified: true, locale: "en", sub: "p5|local-demo", updatedAt: now, }, $setOnInsert: { createdAt: now, image: null }, }, { upsert: true }, ); await db .collection(physicalNames.account) .updateOne( { userId, providerId: "credential" }, { $set: { accountId: String(userId), password: await hashPassword(password), updatedAt: now, }, $setOnInsert: { createdAt: now }, }, { upsert: true }, ); const workspace = await ensurePersonalWorkspace(db, { id: String(userId), email, name: "P5 Studio", username: "p5studio", sub: "p5|local-demo", }); await db .collection(physicalNames.subscriptions) .updateOne( { polarSubscriptionId: "p5-local-pro" }, { $set: { workspaceId: workspace._id, plan: "pro", status: "active", currentPeriodStart: now, currentPeriodEnd: new Date(now.getTime() + 365 * 86400000), productId: "local-fixture", polarCustomerId: "local-fixture", }, }, { upsert: true }, ); const ctx: ServiceContext = { db, cache, workspace, actor: { userId: String(userId), role: "owner" }, linkDomain: shared.LINK_DOMAIN!, }; const destinations = [ [ "p5-portfolio", "Portfolio & selected work", "https://example.com/portfolio", ], [ "p5-newsletter", "Letters from the studio", "https://example.com/newsletter", ], ["p5-music", "São João — música e encontros", "https://example.com/music"], ["p5-contact", "Say hello", "https://example.com/contact"], ]; const linkIds: string[] = []; for (const [key, title, url] of destinations) { let link = await db .collection(physicalNames.links) .findOne({ workspaceId: workspace._id, key }); if (!link) { const result = await createLink(ctx, { key: key!, title: title!, url: url!, }); if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error); link = await db .collection(physicalNames.links) .findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(result.value.id) }); } if (!link) throw new Error("Seed link missing"); linkIds.push(String(link._id)); await db .collection(physicalNames.links) .updateOne( { _id: link._id }, { $set: { safetyStatus: "safe", requiresInterstitial: false, "safety.status": "safe", "safety.interstitial": false, }, }, ); } let page = await db .collection(physicalNames.bio_pages) .findOne({ workspaceId: workspace._id, handle: "p5-studio" }); if (!page) { const created = await createBioPage(ctx, { slug: "p5-studio", title: "P5 Studio", }); if (!created.ok) throw new Error(created.error); const draft = (await readBioDraft(ctx, created.value.id))!; const saved = await saveBioDraft(ctx, created.value.id, draft.revision, { ...draft.content, theme: bioPresets.forest, seo: { title: "P5 Studio", description: "A local P5 demonstration", noindex: true, }, blocks: [ { id: "profile", visible: true, type: "profile", title: "P5 Studio", description: "A small studio making thoughtful things.\nDesign, music & stories — histórias e encontros.", avatar: "", align: "left", avatarShape: "circle", paidBadge: true, }, { id: "intro", visible: true, type: "text", text: "Welcome to your **P5 sandbox**. Edit the blocks, try a theme, then publish to see the public page change.", }, { id: "work", visible: true, type: "header", text: "Around the studio", }, ...linkIds.map((linkId, at) => ({ id: `link-${at}`, visible: true, type: "link", linkId, title: destinations[at]![1], image: "", highlight: at === 0, })), { id: "social", visible: true, type: "socials", items: [ { platform: "github", url: "https://github.com" }, { platform: "instagram", url: "https://instagram.com" }, ], }, { id: "music", visible: true, type: "embed", provider: "youtube", url: "https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ", }, { id: "qr", visible: true, type: "qr", linkId: linkIds[0], title: "Take the studio with you", }, ], }); if (!saved.ok) throw new Error(saved.error); const published = await publishBioDraft( ctx, created.value.id, saved.value.revision, ); if (!published.ok) throw new Error(published.error); page = await db .collection(physicalNames.bio_pages) .findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(created.value.id) }); } credentials = { email, password, dashboard: `${web}/${workspace.slug}/links`, editor: `${web}/${workspace.slug}/bio/${page!._id}/editor`, bio: `${web}/_bio/p5-studio`, }; await writeFile( "/tmp/shortn-p5-login.json", JSON.stringify(credentials, null, 2), { mode: 0o600 }, ); } finally { cache.disconnect(); await client.close(); } await import("./seed-p5-directory"); const children: ChildProcess[] = []; for (const name of ["web", "redirect", "api", "worker"] as const) { const child = spawn( name === "web" ? "node" : process.execPath, name === "web" ? [ "node_modules/next/dist/bin/next", "dev", "--hostname", "127.0.0.1", "--port", String(ports.web), ] : ["--no-env-file", "--watch", "src/index.ts"], { cwd: `${root}apps/${name}`, env: { ...process.env, ...shared, ...(name === "worker" ? { POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN: "" } : {}), PORT: String(ports[name]), }, stdio: "inherit", detached: true, }, ); children.push(child); } console.log( `P5 local sandbox running. Login: ${web}/login; credentials: /tmp/shortn-p5-login.json`, ); process.on("SIGTERM", stop); process.on("SIGINT", stop);

nodes.name: stop
nodes.body_text: function stop() { for (const child of children) { try { process.kill(-child.pid!, "SIGTERM"); } catch { /* Already stopped. */ } } process.exit(0); }

nodes.name: seed-p5-directory.ts
nodes.body_text: /** Additional synthetic large-collection fixture for the local P5 sandbox. */ import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises"; import { MongoClient, ObjectId } from "mongodb"; import { Redis } from "ioredis"; import { physicalNames } from "@shortn/db"; import { createBioPage, ensureTags, readBioDraft, saveBioDraft, publishBioDraft, type ServiceContext, } from "@shortn/core"; const credentials = JSON.parse( await readFile("/tmp/shortn-p5-login.json", "utf8"), ); if (new URL(credentials.editor).origin !== "http://localhost:3100") throw new Error("Local fixture only"); const client = await new MongoClient( "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27020/?replicaSet=rs0", ).connect(); const db = client.db("shortn_p5_dev"), cache = new Redis("redis://127.0.0.1:16380/5"); try { const workspace = await db .collection(physicalNames.workspaces) .findOne({ slug: new URL(credentials.editor).pathname.split("/")[1] }); const user = await db .collection(physicalNames.user) .findOne({ email: credentials.email }); if (!workspace || !user) throw new Error("Start dev:p5 first"); const ctx = { db, cache, workspace, actor: { userId: String(user._id), role: "owner" }, linkDomain: "localhost:3102", } as unknown as ServiceContext; const now = new Date(); const resourceTags = await ensureTags(ctx, [ "Product", "Marketing", "Support", ]); await db.collection(physicalNames.links).bulkWrite( Array.from({ length: 125 }, (_, at) => { const key = `p5-resource-${String(at + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`; return { updateOne: { filter: { workspaceId: workspace._id, key }, update: { $setOnInsert: { workspaceId: workspace._id, key, urlCode: key, domain: "localhost:3102", title: `Sample resource ${String(at + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`, longUrl: `https://example.com/resources/${at + 1}`, hidden: true, safetyStatus: "safe", requiresInterstitial: false, date: now, createdAt: now, }, }, upsert: true, }, }; }), ); const resources = await db .collection(physicalNames.links) .find({ workspaceId: workspace._id, key: /^p5-resource-/ }) .sort({ key: 1 }) .toArray(); // Give synthetic resources useful picker filters without replacing edited tags. await db.collection(physicalNames.links).bulkWrite( resources.map((link, at) => { const tag = resourceTags[at % resourceTags.length]!; return { updateOne: { filter: { _id: link._id, "tags.0": { $exists: false } }, update: { $set: { tags: [ { _id: tag._id, id: tag.id, tagName: tag.name, name: tag.name }, ], tagIds: [tag._id], }, }, }, }; }), ); let page = await db .collection(physicalNames.bio_pages) .findOne({ workspaceId: workspace._id, handle: "p5-directory" }); if (!page) { const result = await createBioPage(ctx, { slug: "p5-directory", title: "Studio resource directory", }); if (!result.ok) throw new Error(result.error); const draft = (await readBioDraft(ctx, result.value.id))!; const saved = await saveBioDraft(ctx, result.value.id, draft.revision, { ...draft.content, blocks: [ draft.content.blocks[0], { id: "directory-intro", visible: true, type: "text", text: "Synthetic demo: 125 sample resources for testing search, pagination and visual editing.", }, { id: "directory-links", visible: true, type: "links", title: "Resources", layout: "paginated", pageSize: 10, items: resources.map((link) => ({ id: `resource-${link.key}`, visible: true, linkId: String(link._id), title: link.title, image: "", highlight: false, })), }, { id: "directory-footer", visible: true, type: "header", text: "Made for testing", }, ], }); if (!saved.ok) throw new Error(saved.error); const published = await publishBioDraft( ctx, result.value.id, saved.value.revision, ); if (!published.ok) throw new Error(published.error); page = await db .collection(physicalNames.bio_pages) .findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(result.value.id) }); } credentials.directoryEditor = `http://localhost:3100/${workspace.slug}/bio/${page!._id}/editor`; credentials.directoryBio = "http://localhost:3100/_bio/p5-directory"; await writeFile( "/tmp/shortn-p5-login.json", JSON.stringify(credentials, null, 2), { mode: 0o600 }, ); console.log(`Seeded 125 synthetic links: ${credentials.directoryEditor}`); } finally { cache.disconnect(); await client.close(); }

nodes.body_text: async function GET( _request: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ handle: string; blockId: string }> }, ) { const { handle, blockId } = await params, bio = await loadPublicBio(handle); const block = bio.content.blocks.find( (b) => b.id === blockId && b.type === "qr", ); if (block?.type !== "qr" || !bio.links[block.linkId]) return new Response("Not found", { status: 404 }); const url = new URL(bio.links[block.linkId]!.href); url.searchParams.set("block", block.id); const svg = await QRCode.toString(url.href, { type: "svg", margin: 2, errorCorrectionLevel: "M", }); return new Response(svg, { headers: { "Content-Type": "image/svg+xml", "Cache-Control": "public, max-age=60", "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff", }, }); }

undefined : t("validation.identifierRequired"), password: values.password ? undefined : t("validation.passwordRequired"), }), { fallbackError: t("errors.network"), initialFormError: oauthMessage, }, ); const usingEmail = form.values.identifier.includes("@"); const onSubmit = form.submit(async (values) => { const identifier = values.identifier.trim(); const viaEmail = identifier.includes("@"); const { error } = viaEmail ? await authClient.signIn.email({ email: identifier, password: values.password, callbackURL: next, }) : await authClient.signIn.username({ username: identifier, password: values.password, callbackURL: next, }); if (!error) return "navigating"; switch (error.code) { case "EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED": rememberVerifyEmail(viaEmail ? identifier : null); router.push("/verify?reason=unverified"); return "navigating"; case "INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD": return { field: "password", error: t("errors.invalidEmailCredentials"), }; case "INVALID_USERNAME_OR_PASSWORD": return { field: "password", error: t("errors.invalidUsernameCredentials"), }; case "INVALID_EMAIL": return { field: "identifier", error: t("validation.emailInvalid") }; case "USERNAME_TOO_SHORT": case "USERNAME_IS_TOO_LONG": case "USERNAME_IS_INVALID": return { field: "identifier", error: t("errors.useEmailToSignIn") }; } return { formError: error.status === 429 ? nodes.body_text: async function WorkspaceLayout({ children, params, }: LayoutProps<"/[workspace]">) { const slug = (await params).workspace; const { session, workspace } = await requireWorkspace(slug); const [list, usage] = await Promise.all([ memberships(session.user.id), usageFor(slug), ]); // Workspace.plan is a migration-era snapshot. Match billing and feature // gates by resolving the subscription mirror, in one query for the switcher. const subscriptions = await collection(await db(), "subscriptions") .find({ workspaceId: { $in: list.map((item) => item.workspace._id) }, status: { $in: [...paidStatuses] }, }) .toArray(); const workspaces = list.map(({ workspace: item }) => summarize( item, resolveEntitlements( subscriptions.filter((sub) => sub.workspaceId.equals(item._id)), ).plan, ), ); const active = workspaces.find( (item) => item.id === workspace._id.toHexString(), ); if (!active) throw new Error("Active workspace is missing from memberships"); return ( <Shell workspace={active} workspaces={workspaces} user={{ name: session.user.name || session.user.email, email: session.user.email, image: session.user.image ?? null, }} impersonating={Boolean(session.session.impersonatedBy)} usage={usage} > {children} </Shell> ); }

nodes.body_text: function toggledFilter( query: AnalyticsQuery, dimension: BreakdownDimension, value: string, ): AnalyticsQuery | null { const filter = filterFor(dimension); if (!filter) return null; const filters = { ...query.filters }; if (filters[filter] === value) delete filters[filter]; else filters[filter] = value; return { ...query, filters }; }

nodes.name: SortColumn
nodes.body_text: type SortColumn = (typeof sortColumns)[number];

nodes.name: SortDirection
nodes.body_text: type SortDirection = "asc" | "desc";

nodes.name: TableSort
nodes.body_text: interface TableSort { column: SortColumn; direction: SortDirection; }

nodes.name: firstDirection
nodes.body_text: firstDirection = (column: SortColumn): SortDirection => column === "name" ? "asc" : "desc"

nodes.name: parseSort
nodes.signature: function parseSort(sort: string | null, dir: string | null): TableSort
nodes.body_text: function parseSort(sort: string | null, dir: string | null): TableSort { const column = sortColumns.find((option) => option === sort); if (!column) return defaultSort; return { column, direction: dir === "asc" || dir === "desc" ? dir : firstDirection(column), }; }

nodes.name: sortParams
nodes.body_text: function sortParams(sort: TableSort): Record<string, string> { if ( sort.column === defaultSort.column && sort.direction === defaultSort.direction ) return {}; return sort.direction === firstDirection(sort.column) ? { sort: sort.column } : { sort: sort.column, dir: sort.direction }; }

nodes.name: nextSort
nodes.body_text: nextSort = (current: TableSort, column: SortColumn): TableSort => current.column === column ? { column, direction: current.direction === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc" } : { column, direction: firstDirection(column) }

nodes.name: TableRow
nodes.body_text: interface TableRow { value: string; label: string; clicks: number; scans: number; }

nodes.name: sortRows
nodes.signature: function sortRows<T extends TableRow>( rows: readonly T[], sort: TableSort, collator: Intl.Collator, ): T[]
nodes.body_text: function sortRows<T extends TableRow>( rows: readonly T[], sort: TableSort, collator: Intl.Collator, ): T[] { const sign = sort.direction === "asc" ? 1 : -1; const measure = (row: T) => sort.column === "clicks" ? row.clicks : sort.column === "scans" ? row.scans : row.clicks + row.scans; return rows.toSorted((a, b) => sort.column === "name" ? sign * collator.compare(a.label, b.label) : sign * (measure(a) - measure(b)) || collator.compare(a.label, b.label), ); }

nodes.name: measure
nodes.body_text: measure = (row: T) => sort.column === "clicks" ? row.clicks : sort.column === "scans" ? row.scans : row.clicks + row.scans

nodes.name: query.ts
nodes.body_text: import type { Dimension, Interval } from "@shortn/core"; export const rangePresets = ["7d", "30d", "90d", "12m"] as const; export const intervals = [ "hour", "day", "week", "month", ] as const satisfies readonly Interval[]; // Filters on event attributes; they need the analyticsBreakdowns feature. export const filterDimensions = [ "country", "device", "browser", "os", "referrer", "utmSource", "utmMedium", "utmCampaign", ] as const satisfies readonly Dimension[]; // Filters that only narrow what is counted (one link, clicks or scans); every // plan has them, since the link and QR pages already show the same numbers. export const scopeFilters = ["link", "kind"] as const; export const queryFilters: readonly QueryFilter[] = [ ...scopeFilters, ...filterDimensions, ]; export const eventKinds = ["click", "scan"] as const; const objectIdPattern = /^[a-f0-9]{24}$/; const DAY = 86_400_000; const defaultRange: RangePreset = "30d"; const presetDays: Record<RangePreset, number> = { "7d": 7, "30d": 30, "90d": 90, "12m": 365, }; const isoDay = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/; /** Whole calendar days the range covers, `to` included. */ // bucketStarts in @shortn/core caps a series at 2000 buckets; these keep // every series well under that and readable. /** Every search param the query owns; pages keep the rest (e.g. `sort`). */ export const queryParamNames: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([ "range", "from", "to", "interval", ...queryFilters, ]); /** Only non-default values, so a plain /analytics URL means "last 30 days". */ /** * Tidies what the filter bar submits: picking "Custom" fills in the last 30 * days, swapped dates are put in order, a new range gets its default * interval, and defaults leave the URL. Params the query doesn't own stay. */ /** The query as a search string, with extra params such as a scope's filters. */ /** Local-time bounds; preset ranges end now and start at a local midnight. */

nodes.body_text: type RangePreset = (typeof rangePresets)[number];

nodes.name: RangeChoice
nodes.body_text: type RangeChoice = RangePreset | "custom";

nodes.name: FilterDimension
nodes.body_text: type FilterDimension = (typeof filterDimensions)[number];

nodes.body_text: type ScopeFilter = (typeof scopeFilters)[number];

nodes.body_text: type QueryFilter = ScopeFilter | FilterDimension;

nodes.name: AnalyticsFilters
nodes.body_text: type AnalyticsFilters = Partial<Record<QueryFilter, string>>;

nodes.name: EventKind
nodes.body_text: type EventKind = (typeof eventKinds)[number];

nodes.name: isEventKind
nodes.body_text: isEventKind = (value: unknown): value is EventKind => eventKinds.some((kind) => kind === value)

nodes.name: filterValue
nodes.body_text: filterValue = (filter: QueryFilter, raw: string | null) => { if (!raw) return null; if (filter === "link") return objectIdPattern.test(raw) ? raw : null; if (filter === "kind") return isEventKind(raw) ? raw : null; return raw.slice(0, 200); }

nodes.name: AnalyticsQuery
nodes.body_text: interface AnalyticsQuery { range: RangeChoice; /** Inclusive calendar days (yyyy-mm-dd) in the viewer's time zone; custom ranges only. */ from: string | null; to: string | null; interval: Interval; filters: AnalyticsFilters; }

nodes.name: parseDay
nodes.signature: function parseDay(value: string | null): Date | null
nodes.body_text: function parseDay(value: string | null): Date | null { if (!value || !isoDay.test(value)) return null; const [year = 0, month = 1, day = 1] = value.split("-").map(Number); const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day); return date.getFullYear() === year && date.getMonth() === month - 1 && date.getDate() === day ? date : null; }

nodes.name: formatDay
nodes.body_text: function formatDay(date: Date): string { const pad = (value: number) => String(value).padStart(2, "0"); return `${date.getFullYear()}-${pad(date.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(date.getDate())}`; }

nodes.name: pad
nodes.body_text: pad = (value: number) => String(value).padStart(2, "0")

nodes.name: spanDays
nodes.signature: function spanDays( range: RangeChoice, from: string | null, to: string | null, ): number
nodes.body_text: function spanDays( range: RangeChoice, from: string | null, to: string | null, ): number { if (range !== "custom") return presetDays[range]; const start = parseDay(from); const end = parseDay(to); if (!start || !end) return presetDays[defaultRange]; return Math.max(1, Math.round((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / DAY) + 1); }

nodes.name: allowedIntervals
nodes.body_text: function allowedIntervals(days: number): Interval[] { return intervals.filter((interval) => { if (interval === "hour") return days <= 14; if (interval === "day") return days <= 731; if (interval === "week") return days >= 14; return days >= 60; }); }

nodes.name: defaultInterval
nodes.body_text: function defaultInterval(days: number): Interval { if (days <= 2) return "hour"; if (days <= 120) return "day"; if (days <= 400) return "week"; return "month"; }

nodes.name: ParamSource
nodes.body_text: interface ParamSource { get(name: string): string | null; }

nodes.name: parseQuery
nodes.body_text: function parseQuery(params: ParamSource): AnalyticsQuery { const rawRange = params.get("range"); let range: RangeChoice = rangePresets.find((preset) => preset === rawRange) ?? (rawRange === "custom" ? "custom" : defaultRange); let from: string | null = null; let to: string | null = null; if (range === "custom") { const start = parseDay(params.get("from")); const end = parseDay(params.get("to")); if (start && end && start <= end) { from = formatDay(start); to = formatDay(end); } else range = defaultRange; } const days = spanDays(range, from, to); const rawInterval = params.get("interval"); const interval = allowedIntervals(days).find((option) => option === rawInterval) ?? defaultInterval(days); const filters: AnalyticsFilters = {}; for (const filter of queryFilters) { const value = filterValue(filter, params.get(filter)); if (value) filters[filter] = value; } return { range, from, to, interval, filters }; }

nodes.name: toSearchParams
nodes.body_text: function toSearchParams(query: AnalyticsQuery): URLSearchParams { const params = new URLSearchParams(); if (query.range !== defaultRange) params.set("range", query.range); if (query.range === "custom" && query.from && query.to) { params.set("from", query.from); params.set("to", query.to); } const days = spanDays(query.range, query.from, query.to); if (query.interval !== defaultInterval(days)) params.set("interval", query.interval); for (const filter of queryFilters) { const value = query.filters[filter]; if (value) params.set(filter, value); } return params; }

nodes.name: normalizeSearch
nodes.signature: function normalizeSearch( next: URLSearchParams, current: URLSearchParams, now: Date, ): URLSearchParams
nodes.body_text: function normalizeSearch( next: URLSearchParams, current: URLSearchParams, now: Date, ): URLSearchParams { const submitted = new URLSearchParams(next); if (submitted.get("range") === "custom") { const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()); let end = parseDay(submitted.get("to")) ?? today; let start = parseDay(submitted.get("from")) ?? new Date(end.getFullYear(), end.getMonth(), end.getDate() - 29); if (start > end) [start, end] = [end, start]; submitted.set("from", formatDay(start)); submitted.set("to", formatDay(end)); } const previous = parseQuery(current); const parsed = parseQuery(submitted); const query = parsed.range === previous.range && parsed.from === previous.from && parsed.to === previous.to ? parsed : { ...parsed, interval: defaultInterval( spanDays(parsed.range, parsed.from, parsed.to), ), }; const params = toSearchParams(query); for (const [name, value] of next) if (!queryParamNames.has(name)) params.append(name, value); return params; }

nodes.name: queryString
nodes.signature: function queryString( query: AnalyticsQuery, extra: Record<string, string> = {}, ): string
nodes.body_text: function queryString( query: AnalyticsQuery, extra: Record<string, string> = {}, ): string { const params = toSearchParams(query); for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(extra)) params.set(name, value); const search = params.toString(); return search ? `?${search}` : ""; }

nodes.name: resolveRange
nodes.signature: function resolveRange( query: Pick<AnalyticsQuery, "range" | "from" | "to">, now: Date, ): { from: Date; to: Date }
nodes.body_text: function resolveRange( query: Pick<AnalyticsQuery, "range" | "from" | "to">, now: Date, ): { from: Date; to: Date } { const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate()); if (query.range === "custom") { const start = parseDay(query.from); const end = parseDay(query.to); if (start && end && start <= end) { const afterEnd = new Date( end.getFullYear(), end.getMonth(), end.getDate() + 1, ); const to = afterEnd < now ? afterEnd : now; return { from: start, to: to > start ? to : afterEnd }; } } const range = query.range === "custom" ? defaultRange : query.range; if (range === "12m") return { from: new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 11, 1), to: now, }; return { from: new Date( today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() - (presetDays[range] - 1), ), to: now, }; }

describe("themeOf", () => { test("round-trips a stored theme, legacy-only fields included", () => { expect(themeOf(appearanceOf(bio))).toEqual(bio.theme); }); test("leaves unset colours out and removes the header", () => { const draft = { ...appearanceOf(bio), header: "none" as const }; nodes.name: profilePatch
nodes.body_text: function profilePatch(saved: ProfileDraft, draft: ProfileDraft) { const patch: Partial<ProfileDraft> = {}; if (draft.title.trim() !== saved.title) patch.title = draft.title.trim(); if (draft.description.trim() !== saved.description) patch.description = draft.description.trim(); if (draft.avatarUrl.trim() !== saved.avatarUrl) patch.avatarUrl = draft.avatarUrl.trim(); if (draft.avatarShape !== saved.avatarShape) patch.avatarShape = draft.avatarShape; return patch; }

nodes.name: themeOf
nodes.body_text: function themeOf(draft: AppearanceDraft): BioTheme { const theme: BioTheme = { ...draft.rest }; const background = draft.background.trim(); const textColor = draft.textColor.trim(); const primaryColor = draft.primaryColor.trim(); const buttonTextColor = draft.buttonTextColor.trim(); const font = draft.font.trim(); if (background) theme.background = background; if (textColor) theme.textColor = textColor; if (primaryColor) theme.primaryColor = primaryColor; if (buttonTextColor) theme.buttonTextColor = buttonTextColor; if (font) theme.font = font; if (draft.buttonStyle) theme.buttonStyle = draft.buttonStyle; if (draft.header !== "none") { const color = draft.headerBackgroundColor.trim(); const image = draft.headerBackgroundImage.trim(); theme.header = { headerStyle: draft.header, ...(color ? { headerBackgroundColor: color } : {}), ...(image ? { headerBackgroundImage: image } : {}), }; } return theme; }

[to, from] : [from, to]; return { ...(start ? { createdAfter: start } : {}), // An exclusive next-day bound includes every instant of the selected day. ...(end ? { createdBefore: new Date(end.getTime() + dayMs) } : {}), }; }

nodes.name: readPreference
nodes.body_text: function readPreference(): ThemePreference { try { const stored = window.localStorage.getItem(themeStorageKey); return isThemePreference(stored) ? stored : "system"; } catch { return "system"; } }

nodes.name: subscribe
nodes.body_text: function subscribe(listener: () => void) { const onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (event.key === themeStorageKey) listener(); }; listeners.add(listener); window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage); return () => { listeners.delete(listener); window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage); }; }

nodes.name: onStorage
nodes.body_text: onStorage = (event: StorageEvent) => { if (event.key === themeStorageKey) listener(); }

nodes.name: serverPreference
nodes.body_text: serverPreference = (): ThemePreference => "system"

nodes.name: useThemePreference
nodes.body_text: function useThemePreference() { const theme = useSyncExternalStore( subscribe, readPreference, serverPreference, ); const setTheme = useCallback((next: ThemePreference) => { try { window.localStorage.setItem(themeStorageKey, next); } catch { // Storage is blocked (private mode, policy): the choice lasts for this page only. } applyThemePreference(next); for (const listener of listeners) listener(); }, []); return [theme, setTheme] as const; }

nodes.name: use-url-tab.ts
nodes.body_text: import { useCallback, useState } from "react"; /** * Tab state mirrored to `?tab=` so a tab can be shared or reloaded. The * first tab is the default and leaves the URL clean; other params stay. * Pass a module-level `tabs` array. */

nodes.name: useUrlTab
nodes.signature: function useUrlTab<T extends string>( tabs: readonly [T, ...T[]], initial: T, )
nodes.body_text: function useUrlTab<T extends string>( tabs: readonly [T, ...T[]], initial: T, ) { const [tab, setTab] = useState<T>(initial); const change = useCallback( (value: string) => { const next = tabs.find((candidate) => candidate === value); if (!next) return; setTab(next); const url = new URL(window.location.href); if (next === tabs[0]) url.searchParams.delete("tab"); else url.searchParams.set("tab", next); window.history.replaceState(null, "", `${url.pathname}${url.search}`); }, [tabs], ); return [tab, change] as const; }

"shortn.at"}`, process.env.LINK_DOMAIN ?? "shortn.at", ) !== handle ) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 }); if (domain && !/^[a-z0-9.-]{1,253}$/.test(domain)) return new NextResponse("Not found", { status: 404 }); headers.set("x-shortn-public-bio", "1"); headers.delete("cookie"); const url = request.nextUrl.clone(); url.pathname = handle ? `/_bio/${handle}` : `/_bio/by-domain/${domain}`; return NextResponse.rewrite(url, { request: { headers } }); } if (internal) { headers.set("x-shortn-public-bio", "1"); headers.delete("cookie"); } return NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } }); }

nodes.signature: async function resolveScope(ctx: Ctx, input: ScopeInput)
nodes.body_text: async function resolveScope(ctx: Ctx, input: ScopeInput) { const scope: AnalyticsScope = { workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id }; const filters: Filters = {}; const scopeFilters: Record<string, string> = {}; if (input.type === "link") { const link = await getLink(ctx, input.id); if (!link) return null; scope.linkIds = [new ObjectId(link.id)]; scopeFilters.link = link.id; } else if (input.type === "qr") { const qr = await getQr(ctx, input.id); if (!qr) return null; const backing = await collection(ctx.db, "links").findOne( { urlCode: qr.key }, { projection: { _id: 1 } }, ); scope.linkIds = backing ? [backing._id] : []; scope.kind = "scan"; if (backing) scopeFilters.link = backing._id.toHexString(); scopeFilters.kind = "scan"; } else if (input.type === "campaign") { const members = await campaignLinks(ctx, input.id); if (!members) return null; scope.linkIds = members.links.map((link) => link._id); // Legacy counts a campaign's clicks by utm_campaign = its title. filters.utmCampaign = members.campaign.title; scopeFilters.campaign = input.id; } return { scope, filters, scopeFilters }; }

nodes.body_text: function narrow(scope: AnalyticsScope, filters: Record<string, string>) { const next: AnalyticsScope = { ...scope }; const link = objectId.safeParse(filters.link); if (link.success) { const id = new ObjectId(link.data); next.linkIds = scope.linkIds ? scope.linkIds.filter((member) => member.equals(id)) : [id]; } const kind = filters.kind; if (kind === "click" || kind === "scan") { if (scope.kind && scope.kind !== kind) next.linkIds = []; else next.kind = kind; } return next; }

nodes.body_text: async function analyticsAction( workspace: string, input: z.input<typeof queryInput>, ): Promise<ActionResult<AnalyticsResult>> { const parsed = queryInput.safeParse(input); if (!parsed.success || !validZone(parsed.data.timezone)) return invalidInput; const q = parsed.data; const ctx = await serviceContext(workspace); const entitlements = await loadEntitlements(ctx.db, ctx.workspace._id); const resolved = await resolveScope(ctx, q.scope); if (!resolved) return { ok: false, error: "not_found" }; const scope = narrow(resolved.scope, q.filters); const requested = { from: new Date(q.from), to: new Date(q.to), timezone: q.timezone, }; if (!(requested.from < requested.to)) return invalidInput; const range = clampRange(requested, entitlements); const span = range.to.getTime() - range.from.getTime(); const previousRange = clampRange( { ...range, from: new Date(range.from.getTime() - span), to: range.from, }, entitlements, ); const breakdownsAllowed = hasFeature(entitlements, "analyticsBreakdowns"); const userFilters: Filters = {}; if (breakdownsAllowed) for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(q.filters)) if (isDimension(key) && !basicDimensions.has(key)) userFilters[key] = value; const filters: Filters = { ...userFilters, ...resolved.filters }; const dimensions = q.dimensions.filter(isDimension); const gated = breakdownsAllowed ? [] : dimensions.filter((d) => !basicDimensions.has(d)); const visible = dimensions.filter((d) => !gated.includes(d)); const optionDimensions = breakdownsAllowed ? q.options.filter( (d): d is Dimension => isDimension(d) && !basicDimensions.has(d), ) : []; const fetchLimit = (d: Dimension) => optionDimensions.includes(d) ? Math.max(q.limit, optionLimit) : q.limit; const without = (d: Dimension): Filters => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(filters).filter(([key]) => key !== d)); const [current, previous, series, rows] = await Promise.all([ totals(ctx.db, scope, range, filters), !q.compare || previousRange.from >= previousRange.to ? Promise.resolve(noTotals) : totals(ctx.db, scope, previousRange, filters), q.series ? timeseries(ctx.db, scope, range, q.interval, filters) : Promise.resolve([]), Promise.all( visible.map( async (d) => [ d, await breakdown(ctx.db, scope, range, d, filters, fetchLimit(d)), ] as const, ), ), ]); const breakdowns: Partial<Record<Dimension, BreakdownRow[]>> = Object.fromEntries(rows); // A dimension's own filter would leave only the chosen value; its choices // come from the same query without it. const options = Object.fromEntries( await Promise.all( optionDimensions.map(async (d) => { const unfiltered = userFilters[d] === undefined ? breakdowns[d] : undefined; const source = unfiltered ?? (await breakdown(ctx.db, scope, range, d, without(d), optionLimit)); return [d, source.slice(0, optionLimit).map((row) => row.value)]; }), ), ); for (const d of visible) breakdowns[d] = (breakdowns[d] ?? []).slice(0, q.limit); const linkIds = [ ...(breakdowns.link ?? []).map((row) => row.value), q.filters.link, ].flatMap((id) => objectId.safeParse(id).success && id ? ""]), ), scopeFilters: resolved.scopeFilters, }, }; }

nodes.body_text: async function invoiceAction( workspace: string, orderId: string, ): Promise<ActionResult<{ url: string }>> { if (!z.uuid().safeParse(orderId).success) return invalidInput; const ctx = await serviceContext(workspace); if (!can(ctx.actor, "billing.manage")) return { ok: false, error: "forbidden" }; try { const client = polar(); const order = await client.orders.get({ id: orderId }); const subscription = order.subscriptionId && (await collection(ctx.db, "subscriptions").findOne({ workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id, polarSubscriptionId: order.subscriptionId, polarCustomerId: order.customerId, })); if (!subscription) return { ok: false, error: "not_found" }; if (!order.isInvoiceGenerated) { if (!["paid", "refunded", "partially_refunded"].includes(order.status)) return { ok: false, error: "not_found" }; await client.orders.generateInvoice({ id: orderId }); return { ok: false, error: "invoice_pending" }; } return { ok: true, data: await client.orders.invoice({ id: orderId }) }; } catch { return { ok: false, error: "generic" }; } }

nodes.body_text: "use server"; import { bioSlugStatus, createBioPage, deleteBioPage, getBioPage, setBioLinks, updateBioPage, } from "@shortn/core"; import { redirect } from "next/navigation"; import { z } from "zod"; import { appearanceOf, appearanceProblem, badLinkImage, badSocial, linksInput, profileOf, profilePatch, profileProblem, socialsInput, themeOf, type AppearanceDraft, } from "@/components/bio/bio-draft"; import { avatarShapes, buttonStyles, headerStyles, } from "@/components/bio/bio-rules"; import { serviceContext } from "../context"; import { jsonFrom, objectIds, text } from "../form-data"; import { revalidateLegacyBio } from "../legacy"; import type { FormState } from "./link-pages"; // Form actions behind the bio page tabs (17): each tab posts its own // section, the checks run here, and a save goes back to the overview. const fieldOf: Record<string, string> = { slug_required: "slug", invalid_slug: "slug", slug_taken: "slug", titleRequired: "title", avatarUrl: "avatarUrl", color: "color", background: "background", headerImage: "headerImage", }; const linkItems = z .array( z.object({ linkId: z.string().max(24), key: z.string().max(64), url: z.string().max(2048), title: z.string().max(120), image: z.string().max(2048), }), ) .max(100); const socialItems = z .array( z.object({ id: z.string().max(64), platform: z.string().trim().min(1).max(32), url: z.string().max(2048), }), ) .max(20); const appearanceInput = z.object({ background: z.string().max(600), textColor: z.string().max(64), primaryColor: z.string().max(64), buttonTextColor: z.string().max(64), buttonStyle: z.enum(buttonStyles).optional(), font: z.string().max(64), header: z.literal("none").or(z.enum(headerStyles)), headerBackgroundColor: z.string().max(64), headerBackgroundImage: z.string().max(2048), socialColor: z.string().max(64), });

nodes.signature: async function selectBioLinksAction( workspace: string, search: string, tags: string[], excluded: string[], capacity: number, )
nodes.body_text: async function selectBioLinksAction( workspace: string, search: string, tags: string[], excluded: string[], capacity: number, ) { const ctx = await serviceContext(workspace); const limit = Math.max(0, Math.min(1000, Math.floor(capacity) || 0)); const skip = new Set(excluded.slice(0, 2000)); const selected: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof searchBioLinksAction>>["links"] = []; const { env } = await import("../env"); const protocol = new URL(env().PUBLIC_ORIGIN).protocol; // At most 3,000 records: 1,000 available slots plus up to 2,000 exclusions. for (let page = 1; page <= 15 && selected.length < limit; page++) { const result = await listLinks(ctx, { search: search.slice(0, 200), tags: tags.slice(0, 50).map((tag) => tag.slice(0, 48)), page, limit: 200, includeHidden: true, }); for (const link of result.links) { if (!skip.has(link.id)) selected.push({ id: link.id, title: link.title || link.key, tags: link.tags.map((tag) => tag.name), href: `${protocol}//${link.domain}/${link.key}`, }); if (selected.length >= limit) break; } if (page >= (result.pages ?? 1)) break; } return selected; }

nodes.signature: async function saveVariantPageAction( workspace: string, id: string, _state: FormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<FormState>
nodes.body_text: async function saveVariantPageAction( workspace: string, id: string, _state: FormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<FormState> { const requested = form.getAll("link"); if (!requested.length) return failed("link_required"); if (requested.length > 500) return failed("invalid_input"); const linkIds = objectIds(requested); if (linkIds.length !== requested.length) return failed("invalid_input"); const uniqueIds = [...new Set(linkIds)]; const values: BuilderValues = { source: text(form, "source").slice(0, 100), medium: text(form, "medium").slice(0, 100), term: text(form, "term").slice(0, 100), content: text(form, "content").slice(0, 100), }; const ctx = await serviceContext(workspace); if (!can(ctx.actor, "resource.update")) return failed("forbidden"); const campaign = await getCampaign(ctx, id); if (!campaign) return failed("not_found"); const links = []; // Validate every owned target before making the first change. for (let at = 0; at < uniqueIds.length; at += 20) { const batch = await Promise.all( uniqueIds.slice(at, at + 20).map((linkId) => getLink(ctx, linkId)), ); if (batch.some((link) => !link)) return failed("not_found"); for (const link of batch) if (link) links.push(link); } const additions = links.filter( (link) => !hasVariant(link, campaign.title, values), ); if (uniqueIds.length === 1 && !additions.length) return failed("duplicate"); if (additions.some((link) => link.utm.length >= maxVariants)) return failed("full", { max: maxVariants }); let saved = 0; for (const link of additions) { try { const variants = withVariant(link, campaign.title, values); const result = await setLinkUtm( ctx, link.id, variants, variants.slice(0, -1), ); if (!result.ok) return saved ? failed("partial", { count: saved }) : failed(result.error, result.detail); saved++; } catch { return saved ? failed("partial", { count: saved }) : failed("generic"); } } if (uniqueIds.length === 1) redirect(`/${workspace}/campaigns/${id}?variant=${uniqueIds[0]}`); redirect( `/${workspace}/campaigns/${id}?variants=${saved}&skipped=${links.length - additions.length}`, ); }

nodes.body_text: toAction = <T, E extends string>( result: | { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: E; detail?: Record<string, string | number | null> }, ): ActionResult<T> => result.ok ? { ok: true, data: result.value } : { ok: false, error: result.error, ...(result.detail ? { detail: result.detail } : {}), }

nodes.body_text: "use server"; import { redirect } from "next/navigation"; import { requireSession, requireWorkspace } from "../workspace"; import { changePlanAction, checkoutAction, portalAction, invoiceAction, setCancelAction, } from "./billing"; import { changeRoleAction, createWorkspaceAction, deleteWorkspaceAction, inviteMemberAction, removeMemberAction, revokeInviteAction, updateWorkspaceAction, } from "./workspace"; // Form actions behind the settings pages (17): they read FormData, return // errors to the form, and navigate on success with a one-line notice. const slugErrors = new Set(["invalid_slug", "slug_taken"]); // Polar hands back absolute URLs; anything else is not a place to send people. // Typing the name guards against deleting the wrong workspace from a stale tab.

nodes.name: SettingsFormState
nodes.body_text: interface SettingsFormState { error: string | null; field?: string | undefined; detail?: Record<string, string | number | null> | undefined; }

nodes.name: text
nodes.body_text: text = (form: FormData, name: string) => { const value = form.get(name); return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : ""; }

nodes.name: fieldOfSlug
nodes.body_text: fieldOfSlug = (error: string) => slugErrors.has(error) ? "slug" : undefined

nodes.name: AssignableRole
nodes.body_text: type AssignableRole = "admin" | "member" | "viewer";

nodes.name: isAssignableRole
nodes.body_text: isAssignableRole = (value: string): value is AssignableRole => value === "admin" || value === "member" || value === "viewer"

nodes.name: isPaidPlan
nodes.body_text: isPaidPlan = (value: string): value is PaidPlan => value === "basic" || value === "plus" || value === "pro"

nodes.name: isExternalUrl
nodes.body_text: isExternalUrl = (value: string): value is `https://${string}` => value.startsWith("https://")

nodes.name: updateWorkspacePageAction
nodes.signature: async function updateWorkspacePageAction( workspace: string, _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState>
nodes.body_text: async function updateWorkspacePageAction( workspace: string, _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState> { const name = text(form, "name"); const slug = text(form, "slug").toLowerCase(); if (!name) return { error: "name_required", field: "name" }; if (!slug) return { error: "invalid_slug", field: "slug" }; const result = await updateWorkspaceAction(workspace, { name: name.slice(0, 64), slug: slug.slice(0, 48), }); if (!result.ok) return { error: result.error, field: fieldOfSlug(result.error) }; redirect(`/${result.data.slug}/settings?saved=1`); }

nodes.signature: async function createWorkspacePageAction( _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState>
nodes.body_text: async function createWorkspacePageAction( _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState> { const name = text(form, "name"); const slug = text(form, "slug").toLowerCase(); if (!name) return { error: "name_required", field: "name" }; if (!slug) return { error: "invalid_slug", field: "slug" }; const result = await createWorkspaceAction({ name: name.slice(0, 64), slug: slug.slice(0, 48), }); if (!result.ok) return { error: result.error, field: fieldOfSlug(result.error), detail: result.detail, }; redirect(`/${result.data.slug}/links`); }

nodes.name: deleteWorkspacePageAction
nodes.signature: async function deleteWorkspacePageAction( workspace: string, _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState>
nodes.body_text: async function deleteWorkspacePageAction( workspace: string, _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState> { const { workspace: current } = await requireWorkspace(workspace); if (text(form, "confirm") !== current.name.trim()) return { error: "confirm_mismatch", field: "confirm" }; const result = await deleteWorkspaceAction(workspace); if (!result.ok) return { error: result.error }; redirect("/"); }

nodes.name: inviteMemberPageAction
nodes.signature: async function inviteMemberPageAction( workspace: string, _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState>
nodes.body_text: async function inviteMemberPageAction( workspace: string, _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState> { const email = text(form, "email"); const role = text(form, "role"); if (!email) return { error: "email_required", field: "email" }; if (!isAssignableRole(role)) return { error: "invalid_input", field: "role" }; const result = await inviteMemberAction(workspace, { email: email.slice(0, 254), role, }); if (!result.ok) return { error: result.error, field: result.error === "invalid_email" || result.error === "already_member" || result.error === "invalid_input" ? "email" : undefined, detail: result.detail, }; redirect(`/${workspace}/settings/members?invited=1`); }

nodes.body_text: async function changeRolePageAction( workspace: string, userId: string, _state: SettingsFormState, form: FormData, ): Promise<SettingsFormState> { const role = text(form, "role"); if (!isAssignableRole(role)) return { error: "invalid_input" }; const result = await changeRoleAction(workspace, userId, role); if (!result.ok) return { error: result.error }; redirect(`/${workspace}/settings/members/${userId}?saved=1`); }

nodes.signature: async function removeMemberPageAction( workspace: string, userId: string, ): Promise<{ error: string | null }>
nodes.body_text: async function removeMemberPageAction( workspace: string, userId: string, ): Promise<{ error: string | null }> { const session = await requireSession(); const result = await removeMemberAction(workspace, userId); if (!result.ok) return { error: result.error }; if (userId === session.user.id) redirect("/"); redirect(`/${workspace}/settings/members?removed=1`); }

nodes.signature: async function revokeInvitePageAction(workspace: string, id: string)
nodes.body_text: async function revokeInvitePageAction(workspace: string, id: string) { const result = await revokeInviteAction(workspace, id); redirect( result.ok ? `/${workspace}/settings/members?revoked=1` : `/${workspace}/settings/members?failed=${result.error === "forbidden" ? nodes.name: checkoutPageAction
nodes.signature: async function checkoutPageAction( workspace: string, plan: string, ): Promise<SettingsFormState>
nodes.body_text: async function checkoutPageAction( workspace: string, plan: string, ): Promise<SettingsFormState> { if (!isPaidPlan(plan)) return { error: "invalid_input" }; const result = await checkoutAction(workspace, plan); if (!result.ok) return { error: result.error }; if (!isExternalUrl(result.data.url)) return { error: "generic" }; redirect(result.data.url); }

nodes.name: portalPageAction
nodes.body_text: async function portalPageAction(workspace: string) { const result = await portalAction(workspace); if (result.ok && isExternalUrl(result.data.url)) redirect(result.data.url); redirect(`/${workspace}/settings/billing?failed=portal`); }

nodes.body_text: async function invoicePageAction(workspace: string, orderId: string) { const result = await invoiceAction(workspace, orderId); if (!result.ok && result.error === "invoice_pending") redirect(`/${workspace}/settings/billing?pending=invoice`); if (result.ok && isExternalUrl(result.data.url)) redirect(result.data.url); redirect(`/${workspace}/settings/billing?failed=invoice`); }
