nodes.name: members.ts
nodes.body_text: import { loadEntitlements } from "@shortn/billing"; import { collection, physicalNames, type Documents } from "@shortn/db"; import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto"; import { ObjectId, type Db } from "mongodb"; import { fail, ok, type Result } from "../result"; import { can, type Role } from "./authz"; import { nowOf, type ServiceContext } from "./context"; import { defaultLinkDomain, type UserIdentity, type Workspace, } from "./service"; const inviteTtlMs = 7 * 86_400_000; const emailPattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/; // Pending invites hold a seat (05 §Seats). A re-invite replaces the // address's pending invite, so that one doesn't count against itself. // The invite is bound to its address: accepting needs a session whose // email matches, so a forwarded link can't be used by someone else. // Anyone may leave; removing someone else needs members.manage, and only // the owner removes admins. The owner can't be removed. export const workspaceSlugPattern = /^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{1,46}[a-z0-9])$/; const reservedSlugs = new Set([ "login", "register", "recover", "reset", "verify", "handoff", "invite", "api", "onboarding", "new", "settings", "account", "_next", "static", "authenticate", "safety", "en", "pt", "es", ]); // Extra workspaces are a paid entitlement of the creator's personal plan. // Only an empty team workspace can be deleted here; personal workspaces go // with the account (05 §Account lifecycle).

nodes.body_text: interface InviteView { id: string; email: string; role: Invite["role"]; invitedBy: string; expiresAt: string; }

nodes.body_text: hashInviteToken = (token: string) => createHash("sha256").update(token).digest("hex")

nodes.body_text: normalizeEmail = (email: string) => email.trim().toLowerCase()

nodes.name: users
nodes.signature: async function users(db: Db, ids: string[])
nodes.body_text: async function users(db: Db, ids: string[]) { const objectIds = ids.flatMap((id) => ObjectId.isValid(id) ? [new ObjectId(id)] : [], ); const docs = await db .collection(physicalNames.user) .find( { _id: { $in: objectIds } }, { projection: { name: 1, email: 1, image: 1 } }, ) .toArray(); return new Map(docs.map((doc) => [doc._id.toHexString(), doc])); }

nodes.name: listMembers
nodes.signature: async function listMembers( ctx: Pick<ServiceContext, "db" | "workspace">, ): Promise<MemberView[]>
nodes.body_text: async function listMembers( ctx: Pick<ServiceContext, "db" | "workspace">, ): Promise<MemberView[]> { const members = await collection(ctx.db, "workspace_members") .find({ workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id }) .toArray(); const byId = await users( ctx.db, members.map((member) => member.userId), ); const order: Record<Role, number> = { owner: 0, admin: 1, member: 2, viewer: 3, }; return members .map((member) => { const user = byId.get(member.userId); return { userId: member.userId, name: typeof user?.name === "string" ? user.name : "", email: typeof user?.email === "string" ? user.email : "", image: typeof user?.image === "string" ? user.image : null, role: member.role, joinedAt: (member.createdAt ?? member._id.getTimestamp()).toISOString(), }; }) .sort( (a, b) => order[a.role] - order[b.role] || a.name.localeCompare(b.name), ); }

nodes.name: listInvites
nodes.signature: async function listInvites( ctx: Pick<ServiceContext, "db" | "workspace" | "now">, ): Promise<InviteView[]>
nodes.body_text: async function listInvites( ctx: Pick<ServiceContext, "db" | "workspace" | "now">, ): Promise<InviteView[]> { const invites = await collection(ctx.db, "workspace_invites") .find({ workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id, acceptedAt: { $exists: false }, revokedAt: { $exists: false }, expiresAt: { $gt: nowOf(ctx) }, }) .toArray(); return invites.map((invite) => ({ id: invite._id.toHexString(), email: invite.email, role: invite.role, invitedBy: invite.invitedBy, expiresAt: invite.expiresAt.toISOString(), })); }

nodes.name: seatsUsed
nodes.signature: async function seatsUsed(ctx: ServiceContext, reinvited: string)
nodes.body_text: async function seatsUsed(ctx: ServiceContext, reinvited: string) { const [members, invites] = await Promise.all([ collection(ctx.db, "workspace_members").countDocuments({ workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id, }), listInvites(ctx), ]); return ( members + invites.filter((invite) => invite.email !== reinvited).length ); }

nodes.name: inviteMember
nodes.signature: async function inviteMember( ctx: ServiceContext, input: { email: string; role: Invite["role"] }, ): Promise<Result<{ invite: InviteView; token: string }, MemberError>>
nodes.body_text: async function inviteMember( ctx: ServiceContext, input: { email: string; role: Invite["role"] }, ): Promise<Result<{ invite: InviteView; token: string }, MemberError>> { if (!can(ctx.actor, "members.manage")) return fail("forbidden"); const email = normalizeEmail(input.email); if (!emailPattern.test(email)) return fail("invalid_email"); // Admins can't create peers of their own rank or above. if (input.role === "admin" && ctx.actor.role !== "owner") return fail("forbidden"); const existingUser = await ctx.db .collection(physicalNames.user) .findOne({ email }, { projection: { _id: 1 } }); if ( existingUser && (await collection(ctx.db, "workspace_members").findOne({ workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id, userId: existingUser._id.toHexString(), })) ) return fail("already_member"); const entitlements = await loadEntitlements(ctx.db, ctx.workspace._id); const seats = entitlements.limits.seats; if (seats !== null && (await seatsUsed(ctx, email)) >= seats) return fail("seats_exhausted", { seats }); const now = nowOf(ctx); await collection(ctx.db, "workspace_invites").updateMany( { workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id, email, acceptedAt: { $exists: false }, revokedAt: { $exists: false }, }, { $set: { revokedAt: now } }, ); const token = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url"); const invite = { _id: new ObjectId(), workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id, email, role: input.role, tokenHash: hashInviteToken(token), invitedBy: ctx.actor.userId, expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + inviteTtlMs), createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, }; await collection(ctx.db, "workspace_invites").insertOne(invite); return ok({ invite: { id: invite._id.toHexString(), email, role: invite.role, invitedBy: invite.invitedBy, expiresAt: invite.expiresAt.toISOString(), }, token, }); }

nodes.name: revokeInvite
nodes.signature: async function revokeInvite( ctx: ServiceContext, id: string, ): Promise<Result<null, MemberError>>
nodes.body_text: async function revokeInvite( ctx: ServiceContext, id: string, ): Promise<Result<null, MemberError>> { if (!can(ctx.actor, "members.manage")) return fail("forbidden"); if (!ObjectId.isValid(id)) return fail("not_found"); await collection(ctx.db, "workspace_invites").updateOne( { _id: new ObjectId(id), workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id, acceptedAt: { $exists: false }, }, { $set: { revokedAt: nowOf(ctx) } }, ); return ok(null); }

nodes.name: findInvite
nodes.signature: async function findInvite(db: Db, token: string, now = new Date())
nodes.body_text: async function findInvite(db: Db, token: string, now = new Date()) { const invite = await collection(db, "workspace_invites").findOne({ tokenHash: hashInviteToken(token), acceptedAt: { $exists: false }, revokedAt: { $exists: false }, expiresAt: { $gt: now }, }); if (!invite) return null; const workspace = await collection(db, "workspaces").findOne({ _id: invite.workspaceId, }); return workspace ? { invite, workspace } : null; }

nodes.name: acceptInvite
nodes.signature: async function acceptInvite( db: Db, token: string, user: { id: string; email: string }, now = new Date(), ): Promise<Result<Workspace, MemberError>>
nodes.body_text: async function acceptInvite( db: Db, token: string, user: { id: string; email: string }, now = new Date(), ): Promise<Result<Workspace, MemberError>> { const found = await findInvite(db, token, now); if (!found) return fail("invite_invalid"); if (normalizeEmail(user.email) !== found.invite.email) return fail("invite_email_mismatch"); const claimed = await collection(db, "workspace_invites").findOneAndUpdate( { _id: found.invite._id, acceptedAt: { $exists: false } }, { $set: { acceptedAt: now, updatedAt: now } }, ); if (!claimed) return fail("invite_invalid"); await collection(db, "workspace_members").updateOne( { workspaceId: found.workspace._id, userId: user.id }, { $setOnInsert: { workspaceId: found.workspace._id, userId: user.id, role: found.invite.role, invitedBy: found.invite.invitedBy, createdAt: now, updatedAt: now, }, }, { upsert: true }, ); return ok(found.workspace); }

nodes.name: changeRole
nodes.signature: async function changeRole( ctx: ServiceContext, userId: string, role: Exclude<Role, "owner">, ): Promise<Result<null, MemberError>>
nodes.body_text: async function changeRole( ctx: ServiceContext, userId: string, role: Exclude<Role, "owner">, ): Promise<Result<null, MemberError>> { if (!can(ctx.actor, "members.manage")) return fail("forbidden"); const member = await collection(ctx.db, "workspace_members").findOne({ workspaceId: ctx.workspace._id, userId, }); if (!member) return fail("not_found"); if (member.role === "owner") return fail("owner_protected"); if ( (member.role === "admin" || role === "admin") && ctx.actor.role !== "owner" ) return fail("forbidden"); await collection(ctx.db, "workspace_members").updateOne( { _id: member._id }, { $set: { role, updatedAt: nowOf(ctx) } }, ); return ok(null); }

nodes.name: removeMember
nodes.signature: async function removeMember( ctx: ServiceContext, userId: string, ): Promise<Result<null, MemberError>>

nodes.body_text: function confirmMongoTarget( url: string, database: string, args: string[], log: (message: string) => void = console.log, ) { const authority = /^mongodb(?:\+srv)?:\/\/([^/?#]+)/.exec(url)?.[1]; if (!authority) throw new Error("Expected a MongoDB connection URL"); const hosts = authority.slice(authority.lastIndexOf("@") + 1).split(","); const local = hosts.every((host) => ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]"].includes( new URL(`http://${host}`).hostname.toLowerCase(), ), ); log( `MongoDB target hosts=${JSON.stringify(hosts)} database=${JSON.stringify(database)}`, ); if (!local && !args.includes("--yes")) throw new Error("Non-loopback MongoDB targets require --yes"); }

The driver connects on first operation; the connect promise is // shared with getMongoClient so a failure resets the singleton.

nodes.name: MongoConfig
nodes.body_text: interface MongoConfig { url: string; database: string; maxPoolSize?: number; }

nodes.name: getMongoClient
nodes.body_text: function getMongoClient(config: MongoConfig): Promise<MongoClient> { if (singleton) { if ( singleton.config.url !== config.url || singleton.config.database !== config.database || singleton.config.maxPoolSize !== config.maxPoolSize ) throw new Error("Mongo singleton already configured differently"); return singleton.connecting; } const client = new MongoClient(config.url, { maxPoolSize: config.maxPoolSize ?? 20, }); const connecting = client.connect().catch((error: Error) => { if (singleton?.client === client) singleton = undefined; throw error; }); singleton = { config, client, connecting }; return connecting; }

nodes.name: getMongoHandles
nodes.body_text: function getMongoHandles(config: MongoConfig) { void getMongoClient(config).catch(() => undefined); if (!singleton) throw new Error("Mongo singleton missing after connect"); return { client: singleton.client, db: singleton.client.db(config.database) }; }

nodes.name: getDb
nodes.body_text: async function getDb(config: MongoConfig) { return (await getMongoClient(config)).db(config.database); }

nodes.name: closeMongoClient
nodes.body_text: async function closeMongoClient() { const current = singleton; singleton = undefined; if (current) await current.client.close(); }

import { resolvePhysicalNames } from "./collections"; import { compareAndSet, runMigrations } from "./migrations/runner"; import type { Migration, MigrationState, VerifyReport, } from "./migrations/runner"; const url = process.env.MONGO_TEST_URL; if (!url && process.env.REQUIRE_INTEGRATION === "1") throw new Error("MONGO_TEST_URL required"); const base: Migration = { id: "0001-safety", phase: "expand", up: async () => {}, verify: async () => ok(), }; (url ? describe : describe.skip)("Migration safety integration", () => { let client: MongoClient; beforeAll(async () => { if ( !url || !["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]"].includes(new URL(url).hostname) ) throw new Error("Local replica set required"); client = await new MongoClient(url, { serverSelectionTimeoutMS: 10000, }).connect(); if (!(await client.db("admin").command({ hello: 1 })).setName) throw new Error("Replica set required"); }, 15000); afterAll(async () => { await client?.close(); }); test("missing legacy index collection fails before any collection is created, including dry-run", async () => fixture(async (db) => { for (const dryRun of [false, true]) await expect(syncIndexes(db, { dryRun, log: quiet })).rejects.toThrow( "Missing legacy collection: urlv3", ); expect(await db.listCollections().toArray()).toHaveLength(0); for (const name of legacyCollections) if (name !== "user") await db.createCollection(name); await expect(syncIndexes(db, { log: quiet })).rejects.toThrow("user"); expect(await db.listCollections({ name: "click_events" }).hasNext()).toBe( false, ); })); test( "index sync honors audited name overrides", async () => fixture(async (db) => { const names = resolvePhysicalNames( '{"links":"audited_links","tags":"audited_tags","click_events":"audited_events","workspaces":"audited_workspaces"}', ); for (const name of legacyCollections) await db.createCollection( name === "urlv3" ? names.links : name === "tags" ? names.tags : name, ); await syncIndexes(db, { physicalNames: names, log: quiet }); expect( (await db.collection(names.links).listIndexes().toArray()).some( (i) => i.name === "v2_domain_key", ), ).toBe(true); expect(await db.listCollections({ name: "urlv3" }).hasNext()).toBe( false, ); expect(await db.listCollections({ name: "tags" }).hasNext()).toBe( false, ); expect( await db.listCollections({ name: "click_events" }).hasNext(), ).toBe(false); expect(await db.listCollections({ name: "workspaces" }).hasNext()).toBe( false, ); expect( ( await db .listCollections( { name: names.click_events }, { nameOnly: false }, ) .next() )?.options?.timeseries?.bucketRoundingSeconds, ).toBe(86400); expect( (await db.collection(names.tags).listIndexes().toArray()).some( (i) => i.name === "v2_tag_name", ), ).toBe(true); expect( (await db.collection(names.workspaces).listIndexes().toArray()).some( (i) => i.name === "v2_workspace_slug", ), ).toBe(true); }), 30000, ); test("batch and archive reject a missing source; an existing empty archive succeeds", async () => fixture(async (db) => { for (const archive of [false, true]) { const migration: Migration = { ...base, }; await expect( runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { log: quiet }), ).rejects.toThrow("Missing source collection"); } expect(await db.listCollections({ name: "missing" }).hasNext()).toBe( false, ); await db.createCollection("empty"); await runMigrations( client, db, [ { ...base, }, ], { log: quiet }, ); })); test("concurrent legacy write causes WriteConflict retry and re-derives from fresh source", async () => fixture(async (db) => { const _id = new ObjectId(); await db .collection("urlv3") .insertOne({ _id, longUrl: "https://old.example" }); let attempts = 0; const migration: Migration = { ...base, }; await runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { log: quiet }); expect(attempts).toBe(2); expect((await db.collection("urlv3").findOne({ _id }))?.destination).toBe( "https://new.example", ); })); test("compare-and-set checks source fields, missing fields and legacyHash", async () => fixture(async (db) => { const source = { _id: new ObjectId(), longUrl: "https://old.example", _sync: { legacyHash: "old" }, }; await db.collection("cas").insertOne({ ...source, longUrl: "https://new.example", _sync: { legacyHash: "new" }, }); await db.collection("cas").bulkWrite([ compareAndSet(source, ["longUrl", "_sync.legacyHash", "missing"], { $set: { destination: "stale" }, }), ]); expect( (await db.collection("cas").findOne({ _id: source._id }))?.destination, ).toBeUndefined(); expect(() => compareAndSet(source, [], { $set: { x: 1 } })).toThrow( "source fields", ); const nullable = { _id: new ObjectId(), value: null }; await db.collection("cas").insertOne({ _id: nullable._id }); await db .collection("cas") .bulkWrite([ compareAndSet(nullable, ["value"], { $set: { destination: "stale" }, }), ]); expect( (await db.collection("cas").findOne({ _id: nullable._id })) ?.destination, ).toBeUndefined(); await db .collection("cas") .updateOne({ _id: nullable._id }, { $set: { value: null } }); await db .collection("cas") .bulkWrite([ compareAndSet(nullable, ["value"], { $set: { destination: "fresh" }, }), ]); expect( (await db.collection("cas").findOne({ _id: nullable._id })) ?.destination, ).toBe("fresh"); })); test("rollback retains target, reverses multiple applied migrations newest first, and continuous skips reverted/paused", async () => fixture(async (db) => { const rolled: string[] = []; const ran: string[] = []; const migrations = [1, 2, 3, 4].map((number) => ({ ...base, id: `000${number}-step`, continuous: true, })); await runMigrations(client, db, migrations, { log: quiet }); await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .updateOne({ _id: "0004-step" }, { $set: { status: "failed" } }); await runMigrations(client, db, migrations, { direction: "down", until: "0001-step", confirmDown: true, log: quiet, }); expect(rolled).toEqual(["0003-step", "0002-step"]); await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .updateOne({ _id: "0004-step" }, { $set: { status: "paused" } }); ran.length = 0; await runMigrations(client, db, migrations, { log: quiet }); expect(ran).toEqual(["0001-step"]); expect( ( await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .findOne({ _id: "0002-step" }) )?.status, ).toBe("reverted"); })); test("duplicate checkpoint keys throw, and default keys separate targets", async () => fixture(async (db) => { await db.collection("source").insertOne({ _id: new ObjectId() }); await expect( runMigrations( client, db, [ { ...base, }, ], { log: quiet }, ), ).rejects.toThrow("Reused checkpoint key"); const counts: number[] = []; await runMigrations( client, db, [ { ...base, }, ], { log: quiet }, ); expect(counts).toEqual([1, 1]); })); test("verify false or exception clears checkpoints and rerun visits lower ids", async () => fixture(async (db) => { await db .collection("source") .insertOne({ _id: new ObjectId("ffffffffffffffffffffffff") }); let fail = true; let throwVerify = false; const migration: Migration = { ...base, continuous: true, }; for (const throws of [false, true]) { throwVerify = throws; await expect( runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { log: quiet }), ).rejects.toThrow(throws ? "bad verifier" : "Verification failed"); const state = await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .findOne({ _id: base.id }); expect(state?.stage).toBe("verifying"); expect(state?.checkpoint).toEqual({}); } await db .collection("source") .insertOne({ _id: new ObjectId("000000000000000000000001") }); fail = false; await runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { log: quiet }); expect( await db.collection("source").countDocuments({ expanded: true }), ).toBe(2); })); test("batch failures resume matching source hash; changed source discards old checkpoint", async () => fixture(async (db) => { const ids = [new ObjectId(), new ObjectId(), new ObjectId()]; await db.collection("source").insertMany(ids.map((_id) => ({ _id }))); let crash = true; let visits = 0; const migration: Migration = { ...base, source: "version1", }; await expect( runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { batchSize: 1, log: quiet }), ).rejects.toThrow("crash"); crash = false; await runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { batchSize: 1, log: quiet, }); expect( (await db.collection("source").find().toArray()).map( (doc) => doc.visits, ), ).toEqual([1, 1, 1]); await db.collection<MigrationState>("_migrations").updateOne( { _id: base.id }, { $set: { status: "failed", stage: "batching", checkpoint: { data_source__source: ids.at(-1) ?? new ObjectId() }, }, }, ); await runMigrations(client, db, [{ ...migration, source: "version2" }], { log: quiet, }); expect( (await db.collection("source").find().toArray()).map( (doc) => doc.visits, ), ).toEqual([2, 2, 2]); })); test("status writes are fenced after takeover and never hide the original error", async () => fixture(async (db) => { await expect( runMigrations( client, db, [ { ...base, }, ], { log: quiet }, ), ).rejects.toThrow("lease lost"); expect( ( await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .findOne({ _id: base.id }) )?.status, ).toBe("paused"); await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .updateOne( { _id: "lock" }, { $set: { holder: null, expiresAt: new Date(0) } }, ); await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .deleteOne({ _id: base.id }); const original = new Error("original migration failure"); let caught: unknown; try { await runMigrations( client, db, [ { ...base, }, ], { log: quiet }, ); } catch (error) { caught = error; } expect(caught).toBe(original); expect( ( await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .findOne({ _id: base.id }) )?.status, ).toBe("paused"); expect( ( await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .findOne({ _id: "lock" }) )?.holder, ).toBe("replacement"); })); test("lease acquisition, heartbeat and fencing use server time despite client clock skew", async () => fixture(async (db) => { const now = spyOn(Date, "now").mockReturnValue(0); try { await runMigrations( client, db, [ { ...base, }, ], { leaseMs: 300, log: quiet }, ); expect( ( await db .collection<MigrationState>("_migrations") .findOne({ _id: base.id }) )?.status, ).toBe("applied"); } finally { now.mockRestore(); } })); test("time-series batch retries after insert-before-checkpoint crash without duplicate legacyIds", async () => fixture(async (db) => { const ids = [new ObjectId(), new ObjectId(), new ObjectId()]; await db.collection("clicks").insertMany(ids.map((_id) => ({ _id }))); await db.createCollection("click_events", { timeseries: { timeField: "ts", metaField: "m", bucketMaxSpanSeconds: 86400, bucketRoundingSeconds: 86400, }, }); // Simulate a crashed insert window: events committed, checkpoint not written. await db.collection("click_events").insertMany( ids.slice(0, 2).map((legacyId) => ({ legacyId, ts: new Date(), m: { kind: "click" }, })), ); const migration: Migration = { ...base, continuous: true, }; await runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { batchSize: 2, log: quiet, }); await runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { batchSize: 1, log: quiet, }); expect(await db.collection("click_events").countDocuments()).toBe(3); for (const legacyId of ids) expect( await db.collection("click_events").countDocuments({ legacyId }), ).toBe(1); await expect( runMigrations( client, db, [ { ...base, id: "0002-wrong-mode", }, ], { log: quiet }, ), ).rejects.toThrow("mode: time-series"); })); test("archive retries preserve original copies; contract dry-run writes nothing and redacts document values", async () => fixture(async (db) => { const _id = new ObjectId(); await db.collection("source").insertOne({ _id, passwordHash: "sensitive-password", ip: "sensitive-ip", }); let fail = true; const migration: Migration = { ...base, phase: "contract", }; const before = await db.listCollections().toArray(); const logs: string[] = []; await runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { dryRun: true, confirmContract: true, log: (message) => logs.push(message), }); expect(await db.listCollections().toArray()).toEqual(before); expect(logs.join()).not.toMatch( /sensitive-password|sensitive-ip|modified-password|sensitive-report/, ); expect(logs.join()).toContain("passwordHash"); await expect( runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { confirmContract: true, log: quiet, }), ).rejects.toThrow("Verification failed"); fail = false; await runMigrations(client, db, [migration], { confirmContract: true, log: quiet, }); expect( (await db.collection(`archive_source_${base.id}`).findOne({ _id })) ?.passwordHash, ).toBe("sensitive-password"); expect( (await db.collection("source").findOne({ _id }))?.passwordHash, ).toBe("modified-password"); })); });

nodes.body_text: import type { Document } from "mongodb"; // Shared by M2 and signup so a legacy-created user and a new signup get the // same personal workspace slug whichever path runs first.

nodes.name: personalWorkspaceSlug
nodes.body_text: function personalWorkspaceSlug(user: Document): string { const text = (value: unknown) => typeof value === "string" ? value : undefined; const source = text(user.username) ?? text(user.name) ?? text(user.email)?.split("@")[0] ?? "workspace"; const base = source .normalize("NFKD") .toLowerCase() .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-") .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") .slice(0, 40) || "workspace"; return `${base}-${String(user._id ?? user.id).slice(-6)}`; }

nodes.name: recipientAllowed
nodes.signature: function recipientAllowed(allowlist: string | undefined, to: string)
nodes.body_text: function recipientAllowed(allowlist: string | undefined, to: string) { if (!allowlist?.trim()) return true; const address = to.trim().toLowerCase(); return allowlist .split(",") .map((entry) => entry.trim().toLowerCase()) .filter(Boolean) .some((entry) => entry.startsWith("@") ? address.endsWith(entry) : address === entry, ); }

nodes.name: Heading
nodes.body_text: function Heading({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) { return ( <Text style={{ color: palette.ink, fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: "28px", margin: "0 0 12px", }} > {children} </Text> ); }

nodes.body_text: function Paragraph({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) { return ( <Text style={{ color: palette.ink, fontSize: 14, lineHeight: "22px", margin: "0 0 16px", }} > {children} </Text> ); }

nodes.name: Muted
nodes.body_text: function Muted({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) { return ( <Text style={{ color: palette.muted, fontSize: 13, lineHeight: "20px", margin: "0 0 12px", }} > {children} </Text> ); }

nodes.signature: function Action({ href, children, }: { href: string; children: ReactNode; })

nodes.body_text: function FallbackLink({ label, href }: { label: string; href: string }) { return ( <Muted> {label}{" "} <Link href={href} style={{ color: palette.signal, wordBreak: "break-all" }} > {href} </Link> </Muted> ); }

nodes.body_text: import { Action, Heading, Layout, Paragraph } from "../layout"; import { messages, type Locale } from "../messages";

nodes.name: BillingNotice
nodes.signature: type BillingNotice = | { kind: "started"; plan: string } | { kind: "changed"; plan: string } | { kind: "scheduled"; plan: string; date: string } | { kind: "canceled"; date: string } | { kind: "payment_failed" };
nodes.body_text: type BillingNotice = | { kind: "started"; plan: string } | { kind: "changed"; plan: string } | { kind: "scheduled"; plan: string; date: string } | { kind: "canceled"; date: string } | { kind: "payment_failed" };

nodes.name: billingSubject
nodes.body_text: function billingSubject(locale: Locale, notice: BillingNotice) { const t = messages[locale].billing; switch (notice.kind) { case "started": return t.startedSubject(notice.plan); case "changed": return t.changedSubject(notice.plan); case "scheduled": return t.scheduledSubject; case "canceled": return t.canceledSubject; case "payment_failed": return t.paymentFailedSubject; } }

nodes.name: body
nodes.signature: function body(locale: Locale, workspace: string, notice: BillingNotice)
nodes.body_text: function body(locale: Locale, workspace: string, notice: BillingNotice) { const t = messages[locale].billing; switch (notice.kind) { case "started": return t.startedBody(workspace); case "changed": return t.changedBody(workspace, notice.plan); case "scheduled": return t.scheduledBody(workspace, notice.plan, notice.date); case "canceled": return t.canceledBody(workspace, notice.date); case "payment_failed": return t.paymentFailedBody(workspace); } }

nodes.name: BillingEmail
nodes.signature: function BillingEmail({ locale, workspace, notice, url, }: { locale: Locale; workspace: string; notice: BillingNotice; url: string; })
nodes.body_text: function BillingEmail({ locale, workspace, notice, url, }: { locale: Locale; workspace: string; notice: BillingNotice; url: string; }) { const t = messages[locale]; const text = body(locale, workspace, notice); return ( <Layout locale={locale} preview={text} footer={t.footer}> <Heading> {notice.kind === "started" ? t.billing.startedHeading(notice.plan) : billingSubject(locale, notice)} </Heading> <Paragraph>{text}</Paragraph> <Action href={url}>{t.billing.action}</Action> </Layout> ); }

nodes.name: bioRules
nodes.body_text: bioRules = (app: "web" | "redirect" | "api" | "worker") => (env: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: z.RefinementCtx) => { const required: string[] = []; if (env.BIO_DELIVERY_ENABLED === "1") { if (app === "api") required.push( "REDIS_CACHE_URL", "REDIS_DURABLE_URL", "IP_HASH_SECRET", "PUBLIC_ORIGIN", ); else required.push("BIO_INTERNAL_SECRET"); if (app === "web") required.push("BIO_API_ORIGIN"); if (app === "redirect" || app === "worker") required.push("BIO_WEB_ORIGIN"); } if (env.DOMAIN_WRITES === "1" && app === "worker") required.push("CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID", "CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"); for (const key of required) if (!env[key]) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: [key], message: `Required for enabled P5 ${app} features`, }); }

nodes.name: productionRules
nodes.signature: productionRules = ( env: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: z.RefinementCtx, )
nodes.body_text: productionRules = ( env: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: z.RefinementCtx, ) => { if (env.NODE_ENV !== "production") return; if ( env.REDIS_CACHE_URL !== undefined && env.REDIS_CACHE_URL === env.REDIS_DURABLE_URL ) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["REDIS_DURABLE_URL"], message: "Production Redis URLs must differ", }); const seen = new Set<string>(); for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(env)) { if ( !/(SECRET|TOKEN|PEPPER|API_KEY)$|^R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY$/.test(key) || typeof item !== "string" ) continue; if (seen.has(item)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: [key], message: "Production secrets must be distinct", }); seen.add(item); } }

nodes.name: liveBillingNeedsMail
nodes.signature: liveBillingNeedsMail = ( env: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: z.RefinementCtx, )
nodes.body_text: liveBillingNeedsMail = ( env: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: z.RefinementCtx, ) => { if (env.BILLING_MODE !== "live") return; for (const key of ["POLAR_ACCESS_TOKEN", "RESEND_API_KEY", "APP_URL"]) if (!env[key]) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: [key], message: "Required when BILLING_MODE=live", }); }

nodes.name: parseEnv
nodes.signature: function parseEnv<S extends z.ZodType>( schema: S, source: Record<string, string | undefined>, ): z.output<S>
nodes.body_text: function parseEnv<S extends z.ZodType>( schema: S, source: Record<string, string | undefined>, ): z.output<S> { // Empty entries in dotenv files mean "not configured". This also lets a // dev launcher mask local files without enabling optional integrations. const configured = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(source).filter(([, value]) => value !== ""), ); const result = schema.safeParse(configured); if (result.success) return result.data; throw new Error( `Invalid environment:\n${result.error.issues.map((issue) => ` ${issue.path.join(".")}: ${issue.message}`).join("\n")}`, ); }

nodes.body_text: import { expect, test } from "bun:test"; import { cacheScripts, createCache, keys } from "./index"; import type { CacheStore } from "./index"; test("keys normalize domain case, trailing dot and port while preserving key case", () => { expect(keys.link("Shortn.AT.:443", "AbC")).toBe("link:shortn.at:AbC"); expect(keys.link("shortn.at", "AbC")).not.toBe(keys.link("shortn.at", "abc")); expect(keys.usage("w", "2026-10", "links")).toBe("usage:w:2026-10:links"); expect(keys.entitlements("w")).toBe("ent:w"); expect(keys.clicksStream).toBe("clicks:stream"); }); test("single-flight coalesces misses and retries rejected loads", async () => { const { cache } = fixture(); let loads = 0; expect( await Promise.all([cache.get("k", 60, load), cache.get("k", 60, load)]), ).toEqual([42, 42]); expect(loads).toBe(1); await cache.invalidate("k"); await expect( cache.get("k", 60, async () => { throw new Error("load failed"); }), ).rejects.toThrow("load failed"); expect(await cache.get("k", 60, load)).toBe(42); }); test("another cache instance invalidates an in-flight load and prevents stale repopulation", async () => { const { store, cache, data } = fixture(); const other = createCache(store, Number); let finish: ((value: number) => void) | undefined; nodes.body_text: function distribute( total: number, weights: ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, number]>, seed: number, ): Array<[string, number]> { const random = createRandom(seed); const jittered = weights.map( ([label, weight]) => [label, weight * (0.8 + random.next() * 0.4)] as const, ); const sum = jittered.reduce((acc, [, weight]) => acc + weight, 0); return jittered .map(([label, weight]): [string, number] => [ label, Math.round((weight / sum) * total), ]) .filter(([, value]) => value > 0) .sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]); }

nodes.body_text: function getLinkDetails( link: LinkRow, intlLocale: string, referrerLabels: Record<string, string>, ): LinkDetails { const seed = hashString(link.id); const random = createRandom(seed); const today = Date.now(); const series = link.trend.map((value, index) => ({ date: new Date(today - (link.trend.length - 1 - index) * DAY) .toISOString() .slice(0, 10), value, })); const last30 = link.trend.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0); const ageDays = (today - Date.parse(link.createdAt)) / DAY; const previous30 = ageDays < 30 ? 0 : Math.round(last30 * (0.6 + random.next() * 0.8)); const regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames([intlLocale], { type: "region" }); const countries = distribute(last30, COUNTRY_WEIGHTS, seed + 1) .slice(0, 5) .map(([code, value]) => ({ id: code, label: regionNames.of(code) ?? code, value, })); const referrerWeights = link.tags.map((tag) => REFERRERS_BY_TAG[tag]).find(Boolean) ?? DEFAULT_REFERRERS; const referrers = distribute(last30, referrerWeights, seed + 2) .slice(0, 5) .map(([label, value]) => ({ id: label, label: referrerLabels[label] ?? label, value, })); const created = Date.parse(link.createdAt); const activity: ActivityEntry[] = [ { id: "created", actor: link.createdBy ?? "API", kind: "created", at: link.createdAt, }, ]; if (ageDays > 3 && random.chance(0.6)) { activity.push({ id: "tag", actor: link.createdBy ?? "API", kind: "tag", at: new Date( created + random.next() * Math.min(ageDays, 20) * DAY, ).toISOString(), detail: link.tags.at(-1) ?? "newsletter", }); } if (ageDays > 10 && random.chance(0.4)) { activity.push({ id: "destination", actor: "Rui Carvalho", kind: "destination", at: new Date( created + (0.3 + random.next() * 0.6) * ageDays * DAY, ).toISOString(), }); } if (link.tags.includes("print")) { activity.push({ id: "qr", actor: link.createdBy ?? "API", kind: "qr", at: new Date(created + 2 * 3_600_000).toISOString(), }); } activity.sort((a, b) => Date.parse(b.at) - Date.parse(a.at)); return { series, last30, previous30, countries, referrers, activity }; }

nodes.body_text: function suggestKey(source: string): string { let slug: string; try { const url = new URL(source); slug = url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).at(-1) ?? url.hostname.split(".")[0] ?? ""; } catch { slug = source; } const words = slug .toLowerCase() .normalize("NFD") .replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, "") .replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/, "") .split(/[^a-z0-9]+/) .filter((word) => word && !STOPWORDS.has(word)); return words.slice(0, 3).join("-").slice(0, 32) || "link"; }

nodes.body_text: function clicksFor(random: ReturnType<typeof createRandom>): number { if (random.chance(0.07)) return 0; if (random.chance(0.05)) return random.int(18_000, 96_000); return Math.round( Math.exp(random.next() * Math.log(6_000)) + random.int(0, 30), ); }

nodes.body_text: function trendFor( random: ReturnType<typeof createRandom>, clicks: number, ageDays: number, weekdayHeavy: boolean, ): number[] { const recentShare = ageDays < 30 ? 1 : Math.max(0.02, 0.6 / Math.sqrt(ageDays / 30)); const budget = clicks * recentShare; const weights = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, index) => { const daysAgo = 29 - index; if (daysAgo > ageDays) return 0; const sinceLaunch = ageDays - daysAgo; const launchDecay = ageDays < 45 ? Math.exp(-sinceLaunch / 6) + 0.08 : 0.5 + random.next() * 0.5; const weekday = new Date(Date.now() - daysAgo * DAY).getDay(); const weekly = weekdayHeavy && (weekday === 0 || weekday === 6) ? 0.35 : 1; return launchDecay * weekly * (0.75 + random.next() * 0.5); }); const total = weights.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) || 1; return weights.map((weight) => Math.round((weight / total) * budget)); }

nodes.name: createRandom
nodes.body_text: function createRandom(seed: number) { let state = seed >>> 0; const next = () => { state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0; let t = state; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; return { next, int: (min: number, max: number) => Math.floor(next() * (max - min + 1)) + min, pick: <T>(items: readonly T[]): T => { const item = items[Math.floor(next() * items.length)]; if (item === undefined) throw new Error("pick() on an empty list"); return item; }, chance: (probability: number) => next() < probability, }; }

nodes.body_text: /** Gamut-maps by chroma reduction, as CSS Color 4 does for sRGB displays. */ /** Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes (2009), severity 1.0, applied in linear sRGB. */ const CVD_MATRICES = { protanopia: [ [0.152286, 1.052583, -0.204868], [0.114503, 0.786281, 0.099216], [-0.003882, -0.048116, 1.051998], ], deuteranopia: [ [0.367322, 0.860646, -0.227968], [0.280085, 0.672501, 0.047413], [-0.01182, 0.04294, 0.968881], ], tritanopia: [ [1.255528, -0.076749, -0.178779], [-0.078411, 0.930809, 0.147602], [0.004733, 0.691367, 0.3039], ], } as const; export const VISIONS: Vision[] = [ "normal", "protanopia", "deuteranopia", "tritanopia", ];

nodes.name: Oklch
nodes.body_text: interface Oklch { l: number; c: number; h: number; alpha: number; }

nodes.name: Vec3
nodes.body_text: type Vec3 = [number, number, number];

nodes.name: clamp01
nodes.body_text: clamp01 = (x: number) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x))

nodes.name: oklchToOklab
nodes.signature: function oklchToOklab({ l, c, h }: Oklch): Vec3
nodes.body_text: function oklchToOklab({ l, c, h }: Oklch): Vec3 { const rad = (h * Math.PI) / 180; return [l, c * Math.cos(rad), c * Math.sin(rad)]; }

nodes.name: oklabToLinearSrgb
nodes.signature: function oklabToLinearSrgb([L, a, b]: Vec3): Vec3

nodes.name: linearSrgbToOklab
nodes.signature: function linearSrgbToOklab([r, g, b]: Vec3): Vec3

nodes.name: isInGamut
nodes.body_text: isInGamut = (v: Vec3) => v.every((x) => x >= -1e-4 && x <= 1 + 1e-4)

nodes.name: inSrgbGamut
nodes.body_text: function inSrgbGamut(color: Oklch): boolean { return isInGamut(oklabToLinearSrgb(oklchToOklab(color))); }

nodes.name: toLinearSrgb
nodes.body_text: function toLinearSrgb(color: Oklch): Vec3 { const direct = oklabToLinearSrgb(oklchToOklab(color)); if (isInGamut(direct)) return direct.map(clamp01) as Vec3; let lo = 0; let hi = color.c; for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) { const mid = (lo + hi) / 2; if (isInGamut(oklabToLinearSrgb(oklchToOklab({ ...color, c: mid })))) lo = mid; else hi = mid; } return oklabToLinearSrgb(oklchToOklab({ ...color, c: lo })).map( clamp01, ) as Vec3; }

nodes.name: flatten
nodes.signature: function flatten(top: Oklch, under: Oklch): Vec3
nodes.body_text: function flatten(top: Oklch, under: Oklch): Vec3 { const t = toLinearSrgb(top); const u = toLinearSrgb(under); return [0, 1, 2].map((i) => decode(encode(t[i] ?? 0) * top.alpha + encode(u[i] ?? 0) * (1 - top.alpha)), ) as Vec3; }

nodes.name: contrastRatio
nodes.signature: function contrastRatio(fg: Oklch, bg: Oklch): number
nodes.body_text: function contrastRatio(fg: Oklch, bg: Oklch): number { const f = luminance(fg.alpha < 1 ? flatten(fg, bg) : toLinearSrgb(fg)); const b = luminance(toLinearSrgb(bg)); const [hi, lo] = f > b ? [f, b] : [b, f]; return (hi + 0.05) / (lo + 0.05); }

nodes.name: Vision
nodes.body_text: type Vision = "normal" | keyof typeof CVD_MATRICES;

nodes.name: simulate
nodes.signature: function simulate(lin: Vec3, vision: Vision): Vec3
nodes.body_text: function simulate(lin: Vec3, vision: Vision): Vec3 { if (vision === "normal") return lin; const m = CVD_MATRICES[vision]; return m.map((row) => clamp01(row[0] * lin[0] + row[1] * lin[1] + row[2] * lin[2]), ) as Vec3; }

nodes.name: closestPair
nodes.signature: function closestPair( colors: Oklch[], vision: Vision, ): { delta: number; pair: [number, number] }
nodes.body_text: function closestPair( colors: Oklch[], vision: Vision, ): { delta: number; pair: [number, number] } { const labs = colors.map((c) => linearSrgbToOklab(simulate(toLinearSrgb(c), vision)), ); let best = { delta: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, pair: [0, 0] as [number, number], }; labs.forEach((a, i) => { labs.slice(i + 1).forEach((b, offset) => { const delta = Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1], a[2] - b[2]); if (delta < best.delta) best = { delta, pair: [i + 1, i + offset + 2] }; }); }); return best; }

nodes.body_text: import { closestPair, contrastRatio, inSrgbGamut, VISIONS, type Oklch, } from "./color-math"; export const TEXT_AA = 4.5; export const NON_TEXT_AA = 3; export const MIN_SERIES_DELTA = 0.08; const THEMES: ThemeName[] = ["light", "dark"]; const CHART_SERIES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]; const surfaces = ["bg", "bg-subtle", "bg-muted", "field", "overlay"]; const textPairs: ContrastPair[] = [ ...["fg", "fg-muted", "fg-subtle"].flatMap((fg) => surfaces.map((bg) => ({ fg, bg, min: TEXT_AA })), ), { fg: "primary-fg", bg: "primary", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "primary-fg", bg: "primary-hover", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "signal", bg: "bg", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "signal-fg", bg: "signal", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "danger", bg: "bg", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "danger", bg: "overlay", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "danger-fg", bg: "danger", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "success", bg: "bg", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "warning", bg: "bg", min: TEXT_AA }, { fg: "tooltip-fg", bg: "tooltip-bg", min: TEXT_AA }, ]; const nonTextPairs: ContrastPair[] = [ ...["bg", "bg-subtle", "bg-muted"].map((bg) => ({ fg: "signal", bg, min: NON_TEXT_AA, })), ...CHART_SERIES.map((n) => ({ fg: `chart-${n}`, bg: "bg", min: NON_TEXT_AA, })), ]; /** Text/non-text contrast, chart-series separation under simulated colour vision, and sRGB gamut, per theme. */

nodes.body_text: type ThemeName = "light" | "dark";

nodes.name: Tokens
nodes.body_text: type Tokens = Map<string, string>;

nodes.name: readBlock
nodes.signature: function readBlock(source: string, selector: string): Tokens
nodes.body_text: function readBlock(source: string, selector: string): Tokens { const escaped = selector.replace(".", "\\."); const match = new RegExp(`(?:^|\\n)${escaped}\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\}`).exec(source); if (!match?.[1]) throw new Error(`No top-level ${selector} block in tokens.css`); const declarations = new Map<string, string>(); for (const [, name, value] of match[1].matchAll(/--([\w-]+):\s*([^;]+);/g)) { if (name && value) declarations.set(name, value.trim()); } return declarations; }

nodes.name: readThemes
nodes.body_text: function readThemes(source: string): Record<ThemeName, Tokens> { const light = readBlock(source, ":root"); return { light, dark: new Map([...light, ...readBlock(source, ".dark")]) }; }

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.signature: function resolve(tokens: Tokens, name: string, depth = 0): Oklch
nodes.body_text: function resolve(tokens: Tokens, name: string, depth = 0): Oklch { const raw = tokens.get(name); if (!raw) throw new Error(`Unknown token --${name}`); const reference = /^var\(--([\w-]+)\)$/.exec(raw); if (reference?.[1]) { if (depth > 8) throw new Error(`Reference cycle at --${name}`); return resolve(tokens, reference[1], depth + 1); } const color = /^oklch\(\s*([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)\s+([\d.]+)(?:\s*\/\s*([\d.]+)(%?))?\s*\)$/.exec( raw, ); if (!color) throw new Error(`--${name} is not an oklch() colour: ${raw}`); const alphaRaw = color[4] === undefined ? 1 : Number(color[4]); return { l: Number(color[1]), c: Number(color[2]), h: Number(color[3]), alpha: color[5] === "%" ? alphaRaw / 100 : alphaRaw, }; }

nodes.name: ContrastPair
nodes.body_text: interface ContrastPair { fg: string; bg: string; min: number; }

nodes.name: runTokenChecks
nodes.body_text: function runTokenChecks(source: string): TokenCheckResult[] { const themes = readThemes(source); const results: TokenCheckResult[] = []; for (const theme of THEMES) { const tokens = themes[theme]; for (const [section, pairs] of [ ["text", textPairs], ["non-text", nonTextPairs], ] as const) { for (const { fg, bg, min } of pairs) { const ratio = contrastRatio(resolve(tokens, fg), resolve(tokens, bg)); results.push({ theme, section, name: `${fg} on ${bg}`, pass: ratio >= min, detail: `${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1`, }); } } const series = CHART_SERIES.map((n) => resolve(tokens, `chart-${n}`)); for (const vision of VISIONS) { const { delta, pair } = closestPair(series, vision); results.push({ theme, section: "series", name: vision, pass: delta >= MIN_SERIES_DELTA, detail: `ΔE ${delta.toFixed(3)} (series ${pair[0]}–${pair[1]})`, }); } const outOfGamut = series.flatMap((color, i) => inSrgbGamut(color) ? [] : [`chart-${i + 1}`], ); results.push({ theme, section: "gamut", name: "chart series", pass: outOfGamut.length === 0, detail: outOfGamut.length === 0 ? "inside sRGB" : `outside sRGB: ${outOfGamut.join(", ")}`, }); } return results; }

nodes.body_text: function formatAge( date: Date, now: Date, units: UIStrings["ageUnits"], ): string { const elapsed = Math.max(0, now.getTime() - date.getTime()); const join = (value: number, unit: string) => `${value}${units.separator}${unit}`; if (elapsed < MINUTE) return units.now; if (elapsed < HOUR) return join(Math.floor(elapsed / MINUTE), units.minute); if (elapsed < DAY) return join(Math.floor(elapsed / HOUR), units.hour); if (elapsed < 14 * DAY) return join(Math.floor(elapsed / DAY), units.day); if (elapsed < 60 * DAY) return join(Math.floor(elapsed / (7 * DAY)), units.week); if (elapsed < 365 * DAY) return join(Math.floor(elapsed / (30 * DAY)), units.month); return join(Math.floor(elapsed / (365 * DAY)), units.year); }

nodes.body_text: function devConfig( input: Record<string, string | undefined>, inherited: Record<string, string | undefined> = {}, ) { const source = Object.fromEntries( Object.entries(input).filter( (entry): entry is [string, string] => entry[1] !== undefined, ), ); const port = (key: string, fallback: number) => { const value = Number(inherited[key] || source[key] || fallback); if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 1 || value > 65535) throw new Error(`${key} must be a valid port.`); return value; }; const ports = { web: port("DEV_WEB_PORT", 3000), redirect: port("DEV_REDIRECT_PORT", 3002), api: port("DEV_API_PORT", 3003), worker: port("DEV_WORKER_PORT", 3004), }; if (new Set(Object.values(ports)).size !== 4) throw new Error("Dev service ports must be distinct."); const webOrigin = `http://localhost:${ports.web}`; const mongo = source.MONGODB_URL || source.MONGODB_KEY || "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27020/shortn_dev?replicaSet=rs0"; const mongoUrl = new URL(mongo); const derive = (name: string) => createHash("sha256") .update(`shortn:local-dev:${name}:`) .update(source.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET || "") .digest("hex"); const warnings: string[] = []; const configured: Record<string, string> = { ...source }; for (const provider of ["GITHUB", "GOOGLE"] as const) { const id = `AUTH_${provider}_ID` as const; const secret = `AUTH_${provider}_SECRET` as const; if ( !webEnv.shape[id].safeParse(source[id] || undefined).success || !webEnv.shape[secret].safeParse(source[secret] || undefined).success || !source[id] || !source[secret] ) { configured[id] = ""; configured[secret] = ""; warnings.push( `${provider} sign-in disabled: configure ${id} and ${secret} in .env.staging to enable it.`, ); } } const storageKeys = [ "S3_ENDPOINT", "S3_REGION", "S3_BUCKET", "S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID", "S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", ]; const configuredStorage = storageKeys.some((key) => Boolean(source[key])); if (configuredStorage && !storageKeys.every((key) => Boolean(source[key]))) throw new Error( `Incomplete S3 configuration: set ${storageKeys.filter((key) => !source[key]).join(", ")} in .env.staging.`, ); const localStorage = configuredStorage ? {} : { S3_ENDPOINT: "http://127.0.0.1:19000", S3_REGION: "us-east-1", S3_BUCKET: "shortn-dev", S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "shortn-local", S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "shortn-local-development-secret", }; const shared: Record<string, string> = { ...configured, ...localStorage, NODE_ENV: "development", MONGODB_URL: mongo, MONGODB_DB: source.MONGODB_DB || decodeURIComponent(mongoUrl.pathname.slice(1)) || "shortn_staging", REDIS_CACHE_URL: source.REDIS_CACHE_URL || "redis://127.0.0.1:16380", REDIS_DURABLE_URL: source.REDIS_DURABLE_URL || "redis://127.0.0.1:16379", BETTER_AUTH_URL: webOrigin, APP_URL: webOrigin, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: webOrigin, AUTH_URL: webOrigin, PUBLIC_ORIGIN: webOrigin, LINK_DOMAIN: source.LINK_DOMAIN || new URL( source.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || source.BETTER_AUTH_URL || "https://staging.shortn.at", ).host, LEGACY_ORIGIN: source.LEGACY_ORIGIN || source.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || "https://staging.shortn.at", LEGACY_INTERNAL_SECRET: source.LEGACY_INTERNAL_SECRET || source.INTERNAL_API_SECRET || "", LINK_ACCESS_SECRET: source.LINK_ACCESS_SECRET || derive("link-access"), CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_SECRET: source.CONFIRMATION_TOKEN_SECRET || derive("confirmation"), IP_HASH_SECRET: source.IP_HASH_SECRET || derive("ip-hash"), POLAR_ENVIRONMENT: source.POLAR_ENVIRONMENT || "sandbox", WORKER_CONSUMER: `local-dev-${process.pid}`, }; // Mask every runtime key so Next/Bun cannot fill a missing staging value // from apps/web/.env.local or a root .env.local. const schemas = { web: webEnv, redirect: redirectEnv, api: apiEnv, worker: workerEnv, }; for (const schema of Object.values(schemas)) for (const key of Object.keys(schema.shape)) shared[key] ??= ""; for (const [name, schema] of Object.entries(schemas)) parseEnv(schema, { ...shared, PORT: String(ports[name as keyof typeof ports]), }); const infrastructure: string[] = []; const local = (value: string, port: number) => { const url = new URL(value); return ( ["127.0.0.1", "localhost"].includes(url.hostname) && Number(url.port || (url.protocol === "redis:" ? 6379 : 27017)) === port ); }; if (local(shared.REDIS_CACHE_URL!, 16380)) infrastructure.push("redis-cache"); if (local(shared.REDIS_DURABLE_URL!, 16379)) infrastructure.push("redis-durable"); if (local(mongo, 27020)) infrastructure.push("mongo", "mongo-init"); if (!configuredStorage) infrastructure.push("storage", "storage-init"); return { shared, ports, warnings, infrastructure }; }

nodes.name: stop
nodes.body_text: function stop(code: number) { if (stopping) return; stopping = true; for (const child of children) { try { process.kill(-child.pid!, "SIGTERM"); } catch { /* Already exited. */ } } setTimeout(() => { for (const child of children) { try { process.kill(-child.pid!, "SIGKILL"); } catch { /* Already exited. */ } } process.exit(code); }, 1500); }

nodes.name: available
nodes.body_text: async function available(port: number) { await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { const server = createServer(); server.once("error", () => reject( new Error( `Port ${port} is occupied. Stop that service or set the corresponding DEV_*_PORT.`, ), ), ); server.listen(port, () => server.close(() => resolve())); }); }
